name: Palehound
bio: With their latest album, Eye On The Bat, Palehound have unleashed a sonic tour de force that cements their status as one of the most exciting and forward-thinking artists in indie rock. Recorded with Sam Evian (Big Thief, Cass McCombs) at Flying Cloud Recordings in the Catskill Mountains, the album is a breathtaking showcase of artistic growth and evolution, with songwriter El Kempner (as well as multi-instrumentalist Larz Brogan) delivering a stunning batch of new songs that brim with energy, vulnerability, and raw emotion. From the explosive guitar riffs to the thunderous drumming and Kempner's signature vocals, Eye On The Bat is the most thrilling and exhilarating album Palehound has made to date. The album's sharp and introspective lyrics explore themes of self-discovery, anxiety, and empowerment, adding a layer of depth and nuance to the album’s uncompromising vision.  In addition to Kempner’s recent work with Bachelor (a collaborative project with Jay Som), Palehound has earned widespread critical acclaim in outlets such as The New York Times, Pitchfork, and NPR, which praised their unique sound and fearless artistic direction. Palehound's has played around the world alongside some of the biggest names in indie rock, including Big Thief, Sylvan Esso, Lucy Dacus, PUP and more. Kempner’s passionate and introspective songwriting has struck a chord with fans and peers around the world, cementing Palehound’s status as a deeply admired and widely influential artist.

name: Oscar Maydon
bio: Part of Mexico's alternative corrido scene, Oscar Maydon is known for his warm, matter-of-fact tenor and distinctive merger of pop melodies, Latin folk, and traditional Mexican music. He emerged with his debut single, "De la Nació," in 2020 and soon teamed up with corrido contemporaries including Natanael Cano and Legado 7. After releasing his first album, GXLE <3, in 2022, Maydon made his debut on the Billboard Hot 100 with 2023's "Fin de Semana," a collaboration with Junior H in January, kicking off a year that saw him release 26 singles including "Antidoto" (featuring Fuerza Regida) and "John Wick" (featuring Herencia De Grandes). In December, Maydon released four singles including "Kim Kardashian" (featuring Tyga) and "Mexican Flan" (featuring Codiciado). Two days later, he delivered his sophomore long-player, Distorsión. In 2024, Maydon scored a major crossover hit with the Fuerza Regida collaboration "Tu Boda," paving the way for his 2025 full-length Rico o Muerto, Vol. 1. Música En Mi Jetski appeared one year later. Oscar Rene Maydon Meza was born in Baja California, Mexico, at the tail end of the 1990s. He launched his recording career in July 2020 with the G24 Records release "De la Nació." It caught the attention of Jimmy Humilde, who was looking for regional corrido artists to join musicians like Natanael Cano on his Rancho Humilde label. Maydon made his Rancho Humilde debut in early 2021 with "En el Espacio," a collaboration with Legado 7. A duet with Cano, "La Noche Empieza," followed in April, and, between solo outings, he also teamed up with Polo Gonzalez on "Finta de Fresa" before the end of the year. Early 2022 saw the release of Maydon's full-length debut, GXLE <3, which included "Finta de Fresa" alongside solo tracks and collaborations with El Chachito, Joel Nuñez, and Ivan Orozco. A string of additional duets followed later in the year, among them "El Buda" with Calle 24 and "Hoy" with Manuel Rodriguez. Maydon enjoyed his U.S. Hot 100 debut when "Fin de Semana," a duet with Junior H, debuted at number 86 on the chart in February 2023. He followed it that year with a quick succession of over two-dozen singles, including "Skin de Bandida" (with Junior H and Gabito Ballesteros), "Cuerno Mio" (with Junior H), and "F*ck" (with Los Gemelos de Sinaloa). In December 2023, Maydon delivered four pre-release singles to streaming: "Tipo Gatsby" (featuring Natanael Cano and Gabito Ballesteros), "Kim Kardashian" (featuring Tyga), "Mexican Flan" (featuring Codiciado), and "Elvira (featuring Gabito Ballesteros and Chino Pacas). Just two days later, he delivered his second long-player, the 17-song Distorsión. With the exception of the aforementioned collaborations, Maydon performed the rest of the album solo and co-produced it with Rancho Humilde label boss Jimmy Humilde. 2024 saw several highly successful collaborations, including the Mexican chart-toppers "Volver Al Futuro" (with Junior H), "Madonna" (with Natanael Cano), and "Corridos y Alcohol" with EDM star Steve Aoki. By the end of 2024, Maydon had also released "Tu Boda" with Fuerza Regida, which reached number 22 on the Billboard Hot 100. The song heralded his third full-length, Rico o Muerto, Vol. 1, which arrived in June 2025. Along with "Tu Boda," it also included the spotlight track "Asquerosamente Rico" with Peso Pluma, as well as more guest spots from Junior H, Anuel AA, and Neton Vega, among others. Maydon remained prolific heading into the next year and kicked off 2026 with the J Balvin collaboration "Poema." It served as the lead single from his next major the release, the lengthy 21-track Música En Mi Jetski. ~ Marcy Donelson, Rovi

name: Intocable
bio: For more than three decades, Intocable has helped define and elevate Mexican music, becoming one of the genre’s most influential and respected groups. Formed in Zapata, Texas, in the early 1990s, the band developed a signature sound blending Norteño tradition, heartfelt storytelling, polished musicianship, and modern production. Led by Ricky Muñoz and co-founder René Martínez, Intocable built a devoted following through relentless touring and a deep connection with fans.  Albums like Llévame Contigo and Es Para Ti helped propel the group into the mainstream, expanding the reach of Regional Mexican music across the U.S., Mexico, and beyond. Their career includes Billboard, GRAMMY® and Latin GRAMMY® recognition, chart-topping hits, major arena tours, and lifetime achievement honors.  In 2026, Intocable continues its legacy with the Cultura Tour, selection to the Hollywood Walk of Fame Class of 2026, recognition as the most RIAA Latin Diamond-certified Música Mexicana band of all time, and the distinction of becoming the first Norteño group with a dedicated SiriusXM station. Their short film, Estamos Todos, reflects a career rooted in innovation, unity, resilience, and heart.

name: Kacey Musgraves
bio: Middle of Nowhere is the sixth studio album from eight-time Grammy Award winner Kacey Musgraves, and is made for two-stepping. The collection draws from a love of Texas dancehall classics, humorous takes on the human condition, and the space where traditional Country borders many sounds including  Norteño and even Zydeco. Fresh yet familiar, and classically Kacey: honest, fearless, immersive, and always ready to wink at life’s twists and turns. Middle of Nowhere, follows 2024’s Deeper Well, which marked Musgraves' biggest debut sales week, landing at No. 1 on the Top Album Sales chart and her fifth No. 1 debut on the Top Country Albums chart. She launched the Deeper Well World Tour with sold-out shows globally, and the album’s single “The Architect” won Best Country Song at the Grammys.  In 2023, Musgraves achieved her first Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 with “I Remember Everything,” her duet with Zach Bryan. The song became the first country duet in 40 years since “Islands in the Stream” by Dolly Parton and Kenny Rogers to top the chart and went on to win a Grammy Award for Best Country Duo or Group Performance. With this win, Musgraves became the only artist ever to receive a Grammy Award for Best Country Album, Best Country Song, Best Country Solo performance and Best Country Duo or Group performance. Over the course of her career, Musgraves has earned eight Grammy Awards, including Album of the Year for Golden Hour.

name: Keith Nieto
bio: Keith Nieto, saxofonista y líder de la agrupación La Maquinaria Norteña, es uno de los artistas más perseverantes y talentosos del medio musical. A lo largo de los años, ha forjado una trayectoria inminente dentro del género regional mexicano con sus hermanos, sin embargo, su gran experiencia es el impulso perfecto para formar su propio camino y presentar sus propias producciones musicales. El liderazgo y experiencia adquirida en La Maquinaria Norteña, mismas que llevaron a Keith a obtener diversas nominaciones en los Latin Grammy Awards, ahora más que nunca lo llevarán a permanecer fiel y leal a sus ideales y sueños, llevando a cabo su carrera como solista y evolución como artista. Junto con Azteca Music Group, Keith Nieto emprende este nuevo camino, consolidándose como uno de los artistas más importantes del género norteño sax y seguir demostrando la calidad y habilidad que caracterizan su trabajo.

name: Oscar Ortiz
bio: Oscar Ortíz Medina, nacido el 12 de septiembre de 2002 en Tijuana, Baja California,ha logrado consolidarse como compositor, intérprete y una de las voces más auténticas del regional mexicano.   Proveniente de una familia musical, inició su camino entre reuniones familiares y redes sociales, destacando por su habilidad con la guitarra y el piano. Su versatilidad lo ha llevado a fusionar cumbia, corridos y balada con una sensibilidad contemporánea y una narrativa profundamente personal.   Con éxitos como “First Love” junto a Edgardo Núñez, que dominó plataformas digitales y listas de Billboard, Oscar continúa ampliando los límites del regional mexicano. En 2025, alcanzó un nuevo hito con su colaboración junto a Carin León, que debutó en el #1 del chart Regional Mexican Airplay de Billboard, consolidando su presencia en la escena internacional.   Ganador de un Premio BMI y nominado a Premios Lo Nuestro 2025 como Artista Emergente, Ortiz reafirma su compromiso con la autenticidad, la innovación y la evolución del género.

name: Pepe Walker
bio: Pepe Walker es un talentoso compositor y cantante de norteño light reconocido por su energía arrolladora y un estilo único que lo distingue en el género. Sus composiciones reflejan con gran autenticidad los sentimientos que busca transmitir, combinando una lírica poderosa con un sonido envolvente.  A lo largo de su carrera, ha tenido el honor de compartir escenario con grandes exponentes de la música, como Gabito ballesteros , Oscar maydon ,Gerardo coronel , Frizian entre otros, consolidando así su nombre en la escena musical.

name: Carín León
bio: Líder en el género y pionero en la evolución del sonido del regional mexicano. Sus melodías y letras audaces invitan a la audiencia a conocer las raíces y la nueva esencia de este particular género musical.  Su talento ha marcado la industria musical y la cultura mexicana a nivel global. La fusión de todas las facetas de Carín como artista, intérprete, compositor y productor dan vida a un movimiento musical que trasciende fronteras siempre poniendo en alto la música mexicana.

name: Cash Cortes
bio: Cash Cortes is a man on the brink of a new sound. A South Florida native raised in Northwest Georgia of Puerto Rican descent, Cash is fusing his Spanish-speaking Caribbean heritage with his contemporary country influence to create a wholly fresh yet familiar take on the Latin country genre that is on the cusp of a nationwide explosion.

name: Kat Luna
bio: Latina Country artist Kat Luna, formerly of Kat & Alex, is embarking on a new chapter as a solo artist. A first generation Cuban American, Kat was born and raised in Miami and grew up singing in church. She decided to pursue music professionally after appearing on “La Voz” at the age of 19. Kat later competed as a solo artist on American Idol, prompting a move to Nashville upon completion of the show. Kat now looks ahead to her next chapter as she continues to record new music with producer Nathan Chapman (Taylor Swift, Keith Urban, Lady A). With her Cuban roots, powerful vocals, and love of country music storytelling, Kat is forging her own path built on her passion for music and commitment to authenticity.

name: Gabito Ballesteros
bio: Gabito Ballesteros is a singer, songwriter, and guitarist from Mexico. He possesses an expressive, reedy tenor singing voice and weds traditional styles -- primarily norteño and mariachi -- to modern melodies and production styles. His 2020 duet with Aldo Trujillo, "El Rompecabezas," brought him his first media and industry attention. He became ubiquitous, frequently issuing solo singles ("El Chaman," "El Sereno") and collaborations. 2022's "AMG" single with Natanael Cano and Peso Pluma debuted inside the Hot 100 before topping the Hot Latin Songs chart. The GB, his debut studio album, appeared in 2024, hitting number five on the Top Latin Albums Chart. He again reached the Top 20 with 2025's Ya No Se Llevan Serenatas. Ballesteros is the son of Gabriel Ballesteros Guzman and Monica Abril Medina. His mother taught him to play guitar at age eight. When he was nine, his parish priest formed a children's mariachi band and enlisted Ballesteros. He spent three years with the group as one of four guitarists. During this time, Carlos Hoyos brought him the Jose Alfredo Jimenez song "El Rey" to perform as a vocal audition piece. He became the group's lead vocalist. While the band attained local renown, Ballesteros was soon singing at street fairs, weddings, quinceañeras, political rallies, and dances on his own as well as with the group. At 12, he entered the Prof. Rafael N. Varela Secondary School and for three years participated in yearly inter-secondary competitions. He always placed first. At 14, Ballesteros decided to pursue a career in music and took summer courses in vocal discipline and guitar playing. He continued to work in church choirs and bands organized by his parish priest -- who meanwhile taught him bass -- and formed the band Diamante Norteno. The group would rehearse in the afternoons after school, writing and posting videos of their songs to YouTube and social media. On social media, he encountered music executive Jesus Salazar, who asked him for more material, which he provided. In September 2014, he performed the song "La Patadita" at the Tucson Expo Center, and in November, Ballesteros signed a representation and promotion contract with Texas' No Name Records and a management deal with Arizona's New Generation Music. The label booked him a recording session with Juarez's La Destructiva Norteño Banda, netting him his first single, "Yo Quiero Ser." It received some regional airplay, but it primarily served to get the young singer live gigs, either solo or as guest vocalist with norteño and mariachi bands. Ballesteros's second single, "El Rompecabezas," was offered in duet with Aldo Trujillo in August 2020. A month later, he released the solo ballad "Fuentes de Ortiz." In March 2021, Ballesteros delivered the live album De Mis Favoritos, Vol. 1. and appeared with Alex Quintero on the live banda single "Hasta la Chanclas" b/w "Leyendo Caro Quintaro." The March 2022 release of the solo "La Chaman" marked the beginning of a prolific singles run for Ballesteros. "El Sereno" followed in May. In June, the singer teamed up with Junior H on "Vamos Para Arriba." It registered 200 million streams, while its video registered 200 million more. The year's biggest achievement was appearing alongside Natanael Cano and Peso Pluma on "AMG." The single exploded. It garnered almost half-a-million digital streams while the video rang up hundreds of millions of views as well. It entered the Hot 100 in the bottom half and eventually peaked at 41. The track later topped the Hot Latin Songs chart and finally put Ballesteros in front of a mainstream Mexican Regional audience. He capitalized on that attention in 2023 with a dazzling run of nine singles -- solo and collaborations -- during the first quarter. "Puro Pa' Delante" appeared in January and was followed by the live "Casa Claras, Cosas Buenas" (with Cano and Tito Torbellino, Jr.). The dramatic "Dante," in collaboration with Calle 24, appeared on February 8 and showcased Ballesteros' dazzling guitar playing. Two days later, "Vete Ya," in duo with Fuerza Regida, appeared and rang up six million streams in two weeks. A week later, "La Bolsa Gucci" with Miguel Cornejo was released and registered more than 15 million streams during the same time frame. On March 3, Ballesteros and Junior H re-teamed for the hit single "Yo Corazon." The track had more than 25 million streams during its first two weeks of release. In May 2024, Ballesteros released his first studio album. Titled The GB, the 22-track set, written primarily by Ballesteros, Daniel Candia, and Alan Lopez, is rich in experimentation and collaboration. The guest list includes Natanael Cano and Peso Pluma ("Lucky Charms"); Kenia OS ("La Nina"); Luis R. Conriquez and Tito Double P ("Belikon"), and many more. The recording debuted at number three at Mexican Regional Albums and at number five at Top Latin Albums. It also reached 65 on the Billboard 200. More singles appeared in 2025, including "Que Pedo" with Eddy and "7 Dias" with Tito Double P. The latter track paved the way for the singer's sophomore full-length album, Ya No Se Llevan Serenatas, which arrived in May 2025, peaking at 15 on the Top Latin Albums chart. Along with singles like "Chrome Hearts," it also featured collaborations with Natanael Cano, Christian Nodal, Carín León, and J Balvin. ~ Thom Jurek, Rovi

name: MŌRIAH
bio: 𝓛𝓪𝓽𝓲𝓷 💃🏽 𝐂𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐲 🤠  MŌRIAH’s Mexican roots are evident in her work as an actress, producer (music & film), recording artist and songwriter. The L.A. native who now calls Nashville home, delivered her debut, “Hasta Mañana,” in English and Spanish last fall. Billboard took note of her “country sound and mariachi flair” while The Tennessean says she is “among the first to blend a strong Latin and mariachi influence into country music,” and Music Row Magazine’s Robert Oermann raves, “It’s high time we had a Latina country star.”

name: Ana Bárbara
bio: Ana Bárbara nació el 10 de Enero de 1971 en Rio Verde, SLP y es reconocida por ser una de las mejores voces de la Música Mexicana. En 1994 lanza su primer álbum Ana Bárbara y rápidamente fue coronada como La reina grupera, publicando más de diez álbumes de estudio en la actualidad. La cantautora ha escrito más de 60 temas, entre los que destacan: Lo busqué, Fruta prohibida, Quise olvidar y ha vendido varios millones de copias de sus discos.    Ana es una de las pocas canta-autoras en lograr el reconocimiento del público a nivel internacional. Además de México y Estados Unidos, cuenta con miles de fans en todos los países de Latinoamérica. Durante sus más de veinte años de carrera, ha destacado en diferentes géneros musicales, desde mariachi hasta pop, pasando por banda sinaloense, grupero y balada romántica con millones de discos vendidos. Su último éxito, “Solos”, ha superado los 27 millones de reproducciones.

name: Vinny Tovar
bio: From Deep in the heart of San Antonio, Texas . Coming straight to you …

name: Emmanuel Cortes
bio: Emmanuel Cortes is a young singer-songwriter born in Arkansas on December 6, 2006. At just 19 years old, he has demonstrated a strong passion for music since he was 14, when he began learning to play the guitar. His musical journey has led him to charting success across multiple categories on Billboard.   His love for music—especially regional Mexican—has driven him to evolve continuously as a singer and songwriter. His compositions, inspired by his own experiences and those of his friends, deliver messages that resonate deeply with listeners.  With outstanding vocal quality, Emmanuel has shown great admiration for artists such as Ariel Camacho, Gabito Ballesteros, and Natanael Cano, and hopes to collaborate with T3r Elemento. With an innovative approach, he defines his sound as “Cumbia Tumbada". "I see my musical proposal as something special, using technology to enhance different sounds that will undoubtedly captivate listeners, bringing love and joy to every song," he says.

name: Xavi
bio: Representing a wave of young artists in the Regional Mexican world, 21-year-old singer/songwriter Xavi arrives with a refreshing sound that reflects the different cultures in which he grew up: Mexican and American. His style includes R&B, pop and urban, all blended with Regional Mexican sounds. After releasing music independently, Xavi caught the attention of Interscope’s executives, who discovered him through social media and the rest is history: he is developing a successful musical career hand in hand with one of the most important labels in global music.  Influenced by the American culture of R&B and Rap, as well as Pop and Regional Mexican that his parents instilled in him, Xavi was creating his own musical style, although it was not until the Covid-19 pandemic that his life was heading towards the music industry. “I didn't choose my career, it chose me. I always liked music but I saw it more as a dream and now I am fulfilling it,” says Xavi, who has been playing the guitar since he was 10 years old.

name: Dani Rose
bio: The songs are big, the melodies are bright, and Dani Rose brings the kind of presence you don’t forget. Nashville-based country artist Dani Rose blends her California free spirit and Virginia roots into a sound that bridges contemporary Country, timeless Pop/Rock, and hooks built to echo long after the last note fades.  An independent force shaping her own lane, Dani has racked up an impressive list of TV and film placements: NFL commercials, CBS’s Fire Country, HBO’s True Blood, CMT’s Nashville, The CW’s Roswell, Fox’s Monarch, Paramount’s Landman, and five episodes of Yellowstone—all without a label. Her recent releases include “I Ain’t Livin’,” a duet with Brent Cobb featured on Yellowstone, and the viral breakout “Girl Math.”  Dani is no stranger to global virality. Her celebration of motherhood, “Got It From My Mama,” became a TikTok phenomenon, rising to #2 on the US TikTok Charts, amassing 1.2 billion views, and inspiring over 1 million user-generated videos.  Onstage, Dani Rose holds her own among the genre’s biggest names: Luke Combs, Morgan Wallen, Tim McGraw, Old Dominion, and has lit up festival lineups alongside The Red Clay Strays, Billy Bob Thornton, and Megan Moroney. Her voice is unmistakably country, her presence powerful, and her music a testament to what happens when an artist leads with vision, grit, and heart.  Dani Rose is the country artist you’ll want to say you knew early because she’s only getting louder.

name: Chiquis
bio: Chiquis, is a dynamic force in the entertainment industry, showcasing her talents as a three-time Latin GRAMMY award-winning artist, businesswoman, author, and media personality. Her journey to success is marked by remarkable achievements and a relentless drive to inspire and empower others. She is now one of the top female Regional Mexican recording artists. Her singles have reached #1 on the Billboard Regional Mexican charts and #1 on iTunes/Apple Music. Chiquis began her career in television, becoming a pioneer of "reality shows" for Hispanics and she is now the star and executive producer of non-scripted shows.   She is one of the most recognized Hispanic celebrities and has graced the covers of major Latin magazines of the United States and Mexico. She published her memoirs “Perdón” / “Forgiveness”, which was featured on the prestigious New York Times Best Sellers list (both English and Spanish versions) followed up by her best selling book UNSTOPPABLE/INVENCIBLE. Chiquis also established BossBee Nation, a charity foundation through which Chiquis continues to fulfill another of her greatest dreams: to help thousands of young people.

name: Marca MP
bio: At 25, Chato— as his fans and friends call him— has established himself as one of the most talented and influential artists in regional Mexican music. As the lead singer and primary songwriter of Marca MP, he has spearheaded a project that went from performing at quinceañeras and local markets in 2018 to becoming an international phenomenon, amassing over 2.5 billion views on YouTube, billions of streams across digital platforms, and one of the most loyal fanbases in the genre.  Marca MP, comprised by Chato (lead vocals and guitar,) Omar Valdivia (guitar,)  Ismael Villano (tololoche) and Ernesto Franco (tuba), performs romantic songs and traditional corridos, through a daring, stripped-down aesthetic. Anchored by guitars, bass and a solitary tuba, the sierreño sound shines brightly within this minimalist framework, generating an intense and immersive musical experience.  Marca MP’s musical proposal has a universal appeal, making it a perfect reflection of a sound that has connected with audiences of all ages thanks to honest, heartfelt lyrics that many listeners deeply relate to. Their meteoric rise has led to major achievements, including winning the “Best Regional Mexican Collaboration” award at the 2023 Latin AMAs for their song “Ya Acabó” featuring Becky G.  In October 2025, Marca MP released their album "Historias Mal Contadas," a project that reflects their artistic evolution and features two collaborations that have already captivated audiences.

name: Christian Nodal
bio: Christian Nodal is a charting singer and songwriter whose sound weds norteño and mariachi by using the accordion to bridge traditions. Nodal was born in 1999 into a musical family; his parents and many of his uncles, aunts, and cousins are musicians. He began writing songs at age 13 and posting videos of his performances on social media. He drew the attention of Fonovisa's A&R department, which signed him in 2016. After inking his record deal, he appeared as a featured vocalist in the video for Los Plebes del Rancho's hit "No Pasa de Moda," which garnered over 22 million hits. Nodal's own debut single, the Salvador Garza-penned "Adios Amor," reached the top spot in the Mexican Regional Songs chart and peaked at number two on the Top Latin Songs chart, where it spent over 25 weeks. The video racked up nearly 300 million views. Nodal followed it with three more singles, including "Problamente" featuring David Bisbal. The latter track placed in the Top 20 on the Mexican Regional Songs survey and within the Top 40 on the Top Latin Songs chart. His debut album, Me Dejé Llevar, was released in August 2017. It topped the Mexican Regional Albums chart, peaked at number two on the Top Latin Albums survey, topped the Mexican Regional Albums chart, and brought home a Latin Grammy.

name: KURT
bio: Soy hijo de Catalina y Edmundo, hermano de Bárbara. Nací en Culiacán Sinaloa y escribo canciones.

name: Cody Johnson
bio: Cody Johnson, who “just might be the future of real country music,” continues to exceed expectations with fans, media and the industry. He has six highly successful albums, including the 2024 CMA Album of the Year Leather. His catalog features four RIAA Platinum #1 singles—“’Til You Can’t,” “The Painter,” “Dirt Cheap,” and “I’m Gonna Love You” with Carrie Underwood—plus numerous Gold and Platinum certifications and 10 billion global streams. His current radio hit, “The Fall” from Leather Deluxe Edition, has over 150 million streams. Last fall, his studio version of fan-favorite “Travelin’ Soldier” debuted at No. 12 on the Billboard Hot 100, the highest-charting song of his career. In 2025, Cody sold 400,000 tickets, landing on Billboard’s Top 100 Tours list. His shows spanned Australia, New Zealand, Europe, and the U.S., including two sold-out nights at Nashville’s Bridgestone Arena. The Tennessean praised, “the evening’s biggest superstar was Johnson’s voice… he unleashes a stunning instrument that leaves his crowd in awe.” Cody’s accolades include CMT Artist of the Year, four CMA Awards, two ACM Awards plus the ACM Honors Spirit Award, three CMT Music Awards, and iHeart Music Awards’ Best New Country Artist. He has appeared on Today, The Kelly Clarkson Show, and The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon, with standout performances at the ACMs, CMAs, CMT Music Awards, and CMT Giants honoring Vince Gill. Last summer, he co-hosted the three-hour CMA Fest with Ashley McBryde.

name: William Beckmann
bio: The details make a difference for William Beckmann. An old-school hopeless romantic and analog storyteller, the Texas-bred Mexican-American singer-songwriter blends country, traditional pop, Americana and Latin influences through his rich baritone and timeless storytelling. With tens of millions of streams and a devoted live following, Beckmann has packed rooms as a headliner and earned support slots with artists ranging from Tucker Wetmore to Kacey Musgraves.

name: Sammy Arriaga
bio: Firmly planted at the intersection of country and Latin music, first generation Cuban American artist Sammy Arriaga, is trailblazing a space few have occupied. His music marries the two cultures through distinct instrumentation, melodic phrasing and authentic storytelling. Pair that with his innovative prowess and social acumen, Sammy is building a brand of his own. Springboarding off his success in the digital space, and confident in who he is as an artist, Arriaga continues his career in lock-step with his new label, Dead Rose Records, in partnership with Walk Off Entertainment. “I’ve turned years of rejection into fuel and I’ve assembled with the best team an artist can ask for. I want indie artists to see that anything is possible and that we have all the tools to make any dream a reality right in front of us. Just gotta want it…And want it bad!”

name: Julio Caesar
bio: Proveniente de Los Ángeles y con raíces en Culiacán, Sinaloa, Julio Cesar Perez Sandoval, conocido en el mundo de la música como Julio Caesar, ha dejado una marca notable en la escena musical a sus 20 años.  A los 15 años, Julio Caesar comenzó su trayectoria en la música, incursionando primero en la guitarra y el acordeón, pero encontrando su verdadera pasión en el bajo quinto. Lo que más le apasiona de la música es la capacidad de expresión, que le permite transmitir emociones de manera única a través de su instrumento.  Además de ser un virtuoso en la ejecución de instrumentos, Julio es un talentoso compositor nato. Sus composiciones inéditas se inspiran en sus vivencias cotidianas, ya sea por un amor, desamor o un día alegre que lo motiva a escribir canciones. Sus influencias abrazan una amplia gama de artistas, desde clásicos como Sergio Vega, Ramon Ayala y Juan Villarreal, hasta los contemporáneos como Natanael Cano, Junior H y Peso Pluma.   Julio tiene claro su objetivo: convertirse en la primera opción musical para las personas, ya sea al sintonizar la radio del automóvil o al ambientar una reunión. Su estilo musical combina lo clásico con lo moderno, reflejando una mezcla perfecta del sierreño con el norteño, logrando una fusión única en su música. Aunque su género principal es el regional mexicano, no se limita a un subgénero específico.

name: Adrien Nunez
bio: Adrien Nunez has quickly emerged as one of country music’s most exciting new artists, surpassing 260 million career streams and earning a Gold record with his debut release, “Low Road,” in just two years.He has toured with Luke Bryan, Kane Brown, Russell Dickerson, and others, while performing Stagecoach’s Mane Stage, Red Rocks, and The Greek Theatre. Adrien has also been featured by The New York Times, competed in the 2026 NBA All-Star Celebrity Game, and made his Grand Ole Opry debut. With his debut album and a 20-date headline tour coming in 2027, Adrien is entering his biggest chapter yet.

name: Ha*Ash
bio: Hanna and Ashley Perez Moza were born in Lake Charles, Louisiana. From a young age, they both felt a strong pull toward a life in music. They began singing in their home church at the ages of five and six. The girls were met with such a strong reception that they began to perform regularly. In doing so, they began taking their craft more seriously and sought out professional instruction. Winning local competitions, followed by regional festival invitations in their early teens, created a buzz around Hanna and Ashley. Their first demo recording soon fell into the hands of A&R at Sony Music. Impressed with the talented adolescents' mix of rock, pop, and country, Sony signed the ladies, calling them Ha*Ash. Their self-titled debut album, under the direction of Aureo Baqueiro, was released in 2003. The record's first single, "Odio Amarte," was a radio hit all over the country, and opened doors for important live and television appearances. Among those opportunities was the recording of the musical theme for the animated film Magos y Gigantes. A number of hit singles later, Ha*Ash were pleased to see their first record go platinum, selling better than 140,000 copies. A year later, the girls released their second album, Mundos Opuestos. While the album didn't sell quite as well, Ha*Ash remained a popular touring entity setting the stage for further chart activity. In 2008, their full-length Habitación Doble peaked at 14 on the Latin Pop Albums charts. While its first single, "No Te Quiero Nada," scored near the top of the Mexican Airplay charts, their second, "Already Home" with Brandi Carlisle, was a massive digital success after being officially downloaded hundreds of thousands of times. 2011's A Tiempo, co-produced by Aureo Baqueiro and Michele Canova, featured collaborations with Leonel Garcia (of Sin Bandera), and Natalia Lafourcade. The video for its fourth single, "Te Dejo en Libertad" with Alejandro Fernández, received over 15 million views, propelling the album to a Top Five spot on the Mexican charts and resulted in both a two-year tour of Latin America and a deluxe edition being issued in 2013. After an extended break, the sisters re-entered the studio and emerged with Primera Fila: Hecho Realidad in 2015. While it peaked at 16 on the Latin Pop Albums chart, the record was notable for the many prize nominations and awards it received, including three Vevo Certified Awards for all three singles -- each reached over 100 million views, an MTV Agents of Change Award, a Premios Juventud for the single "Perdón, Perdón," and nominations for Group or Duo of the Year from Latin Billboard and Premio Lo Nuestro. Ha*Ash received thousands of press accolades for their charity work as well. In 2017, they issued 30 de Febrero, which features collaborations with Abraham Mateo on the title track and Prince Royce on "100 Años." ~ Evan C. Gutierrez

name: Adrian L Santos
bio: EL joven Artista de 19 Años Nacido en Santiago Nuevo Leon Trata de levantar su música dedicándoles canciones a sus Exs, como los reconoce Corridos de Desamor, una rama de Los Corridos Tumbados, Esta Proximo a Sacar Su album

name: Angie K
bio: Angie K has taken the summer by storm hitting the main stage at some of the biggest festivals of the summer including Country Thunder, Boots in the Park, and Tortuga providing support for Jelly Roll, Jake Owen, Carin Leon, Bailey Zimmerman and more. With over 35 million streams and half a million followers as an indie artist, she was named to Apple Music's ‘Trailblazers’ Class of 2025. Her new record ‘Whiskey and Hemingway’ landed on more than 15 editorial playlists and landed her a spot on the Brooks and Dunn tour in October 2026. She is a 3x Opry performer and recently debuted an original version of Disney’s “You Can Fly” for an international Walt Disney World ad campaign. Follow along @officialangiek on Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook.

name: Randall King
bio: A West Texas native and self-described “old soul," Warner Music Nashville's Randall King has never wavered in his honky-tonk allegiance – in fact, he’s worn it like a badge of honor, growing with pride into a leading voice for today’s traditional country. Amassing over 300 Million streams with singles like “You In A Honky Tonk,” “Hey Cowgirl” and “Mirror, Mirror,” he’s kept the twang alive in country’s mainstream while also earning acclaim through deeply personal EPs like 2020’s Leanna, and his 2022 major label album debut, Shot Glass. Schooled on icons like Keith Whitley, George Strait, Alan Jackson and John Anderson, but inspired by modern masters like Dierks Bentley and Gary Allan, King first built an independent, grass-roots following on the strength of his electrifying live shows – each one a harrowing mix of rowdy roughnecking, romantic tenderness and breathtaking emotion – never asking for permission to explore his creative vision. His sophomore major label album Into the Neon, available now, takes that craft to the next level, as King’s neo-traditional roots meet the blood-pumping rhythms and sharp, arena-sized grooves of Y2K-era country and beyond. Co-produced by King and Jared Conrad, and featuring 18 tracks, punchy sounds exist side-by-side with timeless swagger, further blurring the line between yesteryear and today – even as King renews his forever-country vows.

name: Jesse & Joy
bio: JESSE & JOY  Their musical journey began early, but it was in the mid-2000s when they decided to share their art with the world. With their debut album, "Esta Es Mi Vida," in 2006, the duo exuded contagious energy, blending pop and folk influences in a mix that resonated with the hearts of those who listened to them. Songs like "Espacio Sideral," "Llegaste Tú," and "Ya No Quiero" catapulted them to fame, marking the beginning of a successful career.  As their music evolved, Jesse & Joy continued to reap successes with each new release. "Electricidad" in 2009 showed them exploring new horizons, while "¿Con Quién Se Queda El Perro?" in 2011 propelled them to international recognition with anthems like "¡Corre!," "La de la Mala Suerte," and "Me Voy."   "Un Besito Más" in 2015 solidified their status as titans of Latin music, with unforgettable collaborations and soul-touching lyrics. And then came "Aire" in 2020, a breath of fresh air in a world thirsty for hope. With songs like "Alguien Más," "Te Esperé," and "Lo Nuestro Vale Más," the duo challenged genres and won hearts once again.  And when the world came to a halt during the pandemic lockdown in 2020, Jesse & Joy rose to the occasion with "Clichés," a powerful testament to creativity and human connection. Written through FaceTime and masterfully produced by Jesse and Federico Vindver, the album was a beacon of light in dark times, with hits like "Imagina" and "Respirar" resonating in the hearts of their fans worldwide.

name: Alfredo Olivas
bio: Alfredo Olivas es un cantautor y músico versátil que, a su corta edad, se ha posicionado como un artista completo. Gracias a su talento combinado ha logrado poner su firma, su sello, su estilo y su voz en los temas que integran su repertorio. Además de componer toca el acordeón, canta, dirige a los músicos, produce y se encarga de los arreglos en el estudio y en sus presentaciones en vivo.  Realizó su primera grabación a los 12 años, sin embargo, inauguró su carrera de manera profesional cinco años después con el lanzamiento del álbum "El Patroncito". Otras obras de su autoría que lo han consolidado como autor son La Mejor De Las Historias, El Día De Los Muertos, En Definitiva, El Problema, Sin Memoria (dueto con Julión Álvarez), El Sillón, El Zoológico, Volverá y El Paciente, distinguida con el galardón Éxito SACM 2019 como una de las canciones más sonadas, otorgado por la Sociedad de Autores y Compositores de México.

name: La Maquinaria Norteña
bio: Tal cual máquina de fuerza,   ha sido la historia musical de La Maquinaria Norteña, quienes en 2006 inician su camino para darle frescura a las nuevas generaciones que ya bailaban el norteño con saxofón.  Conformado por la inigualable voz de Sergio Soto“La Mozka” , bateria y segunda voz de Tony Nieto, el saxofón de Diego Ojeda,  el bajo eléctrico de Dany Marquez.  Su exitosa historia musical cuenta con nominaciones a Premios Grammy, Latin Grammy, Premio Lo Nuestro, Premios Texas, Bandamax, su música ha llenado salones de baile así como el imponente Rodeo de Houston, y  Arena Ciudad de México. En este 2026, La Maquinaria Norteña celebra con orgullo 20 años de trayectoria artística, consolidándose como una de las agrupaciones más representativas del género norteño.  Queeee Maquinaria Compadreee!

name: Louie TheSinger
bio: Louie TheSinger is a Fort Worth, Texas-Born Mexican country music sensation. Tokenized for creating “Country music with flavor,” his music are a representation of his Texas and Mexican roots while still bringing something new and fresh to the country music scene.  Louie has gained over 1.5 million followers on social media and has begun touring across the nation. He has had an uplifting journey getting here from a rough upbringing to a stint in prison which he speaks of on his track “Sending Me Back.” Once he was released he put his mind on music and rose to fame with his incredible vocals and uplifting persona.

name: Kenia Os
bio: Kenia Guadalupe Flores Osuna, mejor conocida como Kenia Os y apodada "La mexa que tiene a to' el mundo loco", nació en Mazatlán, Sinaloa, México, el 15 de julio de 1999. Su trayectoria como cantante comenzó en 2018. A lo largo de 2019, continuó lanzando música como solista. Cuenta con múltiples colaboraciones con artistas nacionales e internacionales como: Peso Pluma, Anitta, Aitana, Villano Antillano, Bella Poarch, Luísa Sonza, Rels B, Belinda, Ha*Ash, Thalia, Miranda!, La Joaqui, Danny Ocean, Yeri Mua, Carla Morrison entre otros. En octubre de 2021 firmó contrato con Sony y, desde entonces, ha lanzado álbumes y varios sencillos que la llevaron a convertirse en la artista mexicana más escuchada en Spotify México en 2023 y 2024. Su álbum debut Cambios de Luna, lanzado en marzo 2022, debutó en el puesto #6 del Top Albums Global, y su segundo álbum K23, lanzado en octubre del mismo año debutó en el #2. Ambos marcan los debuts más altos de álbumes por una artista mexicana. En 2023, Kenia OS recibió su primera nominación al Latin Grammy por su cortometraje Universo K23, en la categoría de “Mejor Video Musical Versión Larga” Su 3er álbum Pink Aura fue lanzado en 2024 y se convirtió en el álbum más escuchado en un solo día por una artista mexicana en Spotify México, debutando en #5 del Top Albums Debut Global K DE KARMA entró en el Top Albums Debut Global en el #3 y por primera vez en US en #9 Ha sido la mujer mexicana más escuchada por dos años consecutivos (2023, 2024)

name: ELENA ROSE
bio: Andrea Elena Mangiamarchi, better known as Elena Rose, is a Latin Grammy-nominated singer-songwriter. Her lyrical prowess is echoed in hits by performers like Becky G, Rauw Alejandro, Selena Gomez, Daddy Yankee, Christina Aguilera, and Jennifer Lopez. With an impactful career as a songwriter, Elena decided to be the voice for her lyrics by launching her career as a solo artist in 2020. That same year Elena was distinguished an “Artist on The Rise” by Billboard and has since garnered more than 8 million monthly listeners on Spotify and received nominations for Premios Juventud and Premio Lo Nuestro. Her first single “Sandunga” was a prelude to the expansive repertoire that was to come, which now includes 11 tracks with the two most recent hits being “Bayamon” and “El Hombre.” As an artist, she has co-written and featured on Bad Bunny’s "Party,” Mora’s "Playa Privada," Sebastian Yatra’s "Quererte Bonito" and Becky G’s "Flashback.”     Born in Miami to a Venezuelan mother and Chilean father and raised between Puerto Rico and Venezuela, music has always been an unquestioned constant in Elena's life. After spending some time as a songwriter, Elena decided to be the voice of her lyrics to touch and connect with people across the globe. Elena introduces new music with an intuitive and direct approach that empowers and inspires her listeners, while injecting them with a dose of her unrivaled attitude and refreshing self-assurance.

name: Jacqie Rivera
bio: Daughter of the famous regional Mexican artist, Jenni Rivera, and proud native of California, Jacquelin Melina Campos, known professionally as Jacqie Rivera, grew up immersed in the world of music since her childhood. She undoubtedly inherited her mother's talent and today stands out As one of the most promising emerging artists on the scene today, Jacqie has charted her own path in music by fusing a variety of sounds that reflect her Mexican-American roots, thus creating what she calls "Fusion Music.  With more than 3.5 million on her social media and with her singles accumulating more than 11 million views, Jacqie is fully immersed in the creation of new material. Her music attracts a captivated audience eager to hear her majestic voice, honoring the legacy of the unforgettable “La Diva De La Banda,” Jenni Rivera.

name: Chase Matthew
bio: Warner Records Nashville’s Chase Matthew is one of country music’s boldest new voices, blending small-town grit with arena-ready ambition. With his current single, “Holdin’ It Down,” charging up the country radio charts (following his 2025 multi-week No. 1 “Darlin’”), the Nashville native continues his rapid rise — boasting more than 1.7 BILLION global streams and a loyal 2.5M+ social following, while gearing up for his next album, arriving summer 2026. Known for his country-or-nothing attitude, rowdy live shows, and signature low-slung twang, Matthew recently earned his first iHeartRadio Award nomination for Best New Country Artist of the Year and was named one of CRS’ New Faces of 2026, adding to a growing list of accolades that includes HITS One to Watch, iHeart On The Verge (2025), MusicRow’s Next Big Thing, Opry NextStage (Class of 2024), and Billboard’s Rookie of the Month. Currently headlining his Holdin’ It Down World Tour across the U.S. and Australia through summer 2026, he most recently served as direct support on Keith Urban’s HIGH AND ALIVE WORLD TOUR, with previous tours alongside Jason Aldean and Luke Bryan.

name: Fernando & Sorocaba
bio: Ao longo de 19 anos de carreira, Fernando & Sorocaba somam mais de dois mil shows, no Brasil, Estados Unidos, Europa e América Latina. As apresentações, compostas por um repertório autoral, grandes hits e, tecnologia e efeitos especiais e interatividade conectam o público à turnê . Interatividade, exclusividade e inovação são marcas registradas da dupla, que desde o início visa surpreender os amantes de música sertaneja em seu espetáculo. Quando falamos em números, Fernando & Sorocaba se destacam novamente: a dupla tem mais de 1.1 bilhão de visualizações no YouTube em seus quase 300 vídeos lançados, além de contabilizar 2,8 milhões de inscritos no canal. Também somam cerca de 4 milhões de fãs no Spotify e mais de 7 milhões de ouvintes mensais na plataforma. Além da música, os cantores se destacam também na publicidade. São um dos poucos artistas que têm grandes marcas, de diversos segmentos, associadas ao seu próprio nome e com parcerias duradouras, como: Ford e Frimesa, por exemplo

name: EZ Band
bio: EZ Band was founded by Agustin, Jaime's father, alongside Jaime's uncles, Kiko and Nico, under the name "Viento Norteño". Together, they laid the foundation for a rich musical tradition, showcasing vibrant Norteño sounds. Over time, the band evolved, blending Norteño, Cumbia, and other genres into the unique sound fans know today.  Known for creating Spanglish renditions of timeless songs, EZ Band bridges linguistic and cultural divides with every performance, uniting audiences through the universal language of music. Their innovative adaptations resonate with Spanish and English speakers alike, blending nostalgia with a refreshing twist.  EZ Band has gone viral across social media, amassing millions of likes and followers. They’ve been featured in outlets like The New York Times, NPR, and Houston media such as ABC13. They've played at the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo, Miller Outdoor Theatre, and even the halftime show for the Houston Dynamo. From viral covers to original compositions, EZ Band captivates fans worldwide. With a growing global following, EZ Band is more than a band—it’s a cultural movement, bringing people together one Spanglish song at a time.

name: Roan Ash
bio: A South Africa native now based in Nashville, Roan Ash is a Country-rock poet with a border crossing sound, who’s only true allegiance is to the North Star of lyrical authenticity. With his emotionally charged songwriting, there’s no formula for success, no secret plan designed to corner a segment of the market. Just a deep-thinking guitar slinger committed to universal honesty. Learning a few guitar chords from an older sister, he grew up inspired by lyrical masters like Kris Kristofferson and Don Williams, then added admiration for Bruce Springsteen, Elton John, John Mayer and more as a teen. Ash released his first independent album, The Traveller, in 2014, followed by 2018’s Whiskey to My Soul, where he found his creative mark. Finding a natural home for his writing in Nashville, Ash made the life-changing decision to move across the globe and begin writing with Music City’s brightest collaborators. As he readies his first major label release, he’s following the same formula as ever: a lack thereof. No master plan. Just honest, straight from-the-heart music. Because for Ash, music isn’t business. It’s about following your heart, inviting people in and letting the wind take you where it will.

name: Kane Brown
bio: Named to the 2021 Time100 list of the most influential people in the world, 5X American Music Award (AMA) winner. Noted as the “future of Country” (Billboard) and one of “31 People Changing the South” (Time), the chart-topping entertainer earned an ACM Album of the Year nomination for Mixtape Vol. 1 , (2020) and won an ACM Video of the Year Award for his anthem “Worldwide Beautiful.” Brown first broke through with his No. 1 self-titled debut album, which spent 13 weeks at the top of the chart and helped him become the first artist in Billboard history to top all 5 Billboard Country charts simultaneously. Brown’s “Heaven” and “What Ifs” are the 3rd and 7th most streamed country songs of all time. Brown’s sophomore album Experiment debuted No. 1 on the Billboard 200 and solidified Brown as the only male country artist in more than 24 years to achieve this all-genre chart feat. Experiment produced three back-to-back Double Platinum No. 1 hits and was ranked by The New York Times as one of the Top 10 Best Albums of the Year. Brown’s current top 10 and climbing hit, “One Mississippi” released on the heels of his three-time CMA nominated multi-week No. 1 single with Chris Young, “Famous Friends.” Brown recently released his latest collaboration, “Blessed & Free" with Grammy and Oscar Award winning artist, H.E.R. to critical acclaim from The New York Times, Billboard, Rolling Stone, American Songwriter and UPROXX.

name: La Energia Nortena
bio: Based in Dallas, Texas, prolific regional Mexican group La Energía Norteña play romantic norteño music. They formed in 2010 and made their commercial recording debut with the single "Te Recordare." Their debut album, Pensando en Ti appeared in 2012, and was followed by Sin Restricciones a year later. 2014's Cruzando Territorio made the Mexican Regional Albums chart. They played a yearly cycle of touring and recording with albums including 2015's El Rompecabezas, 2016's No Hey Quinto Malo, 2018's El Sueno Americano, and El Crossover. La Energía Norteña released the charting Diez in October 2020, which was followed by El Crossover 2 in 2021. After a pair of live albums, they returned to studio work with 2023's Fuera de Serie. Gratitud appeared in December 2024. Following 2025's QUINCEANERA, they issued EnerGitimo with Grupo Legitimo in April 2026. La Energía Norteña formed in 2010 to play weddings and quinceañeras. After winning a local talent contest, they made their commercial recording debut with the single "Te Recordare" on Fonovisia's Azteca Records. They continued playing regional fairs -- state, county, and city -- and weddings and private parties. They also continued releasing singles and videos, and contributed tracks to various-artists compilations, expanding their fan base and popular profile. In 2012, Azteca released Pensando en Ti, their debut album, and followed with Sin Restricciones a year later. Neither album charted, though they did receive substantial radio play enabling them to perform a live unplugged concert on television. Their third album, 2014's Cruzando Territorio, reached number five on the Top Latin Albums chart. The group began touring the American Southwest and the northern states of Mexico, drawing larger and larger crowds. In July of 2015, they issued the pre-release single "Me Dejaste Solo," which peaked in the Top 30 of the Mexican Regional Songs chart, and followed it with the album El Rompecabezas; it garnered the band another charting single in "Malditos Sentimientos," a number two placement on the Mexican Regional Albums charts, and a Latin Grammy nomination. They toured hard, almost incessantly, until re-entering the studio in the spring of 2016. The pre-release single "Hoy Ma Tocer Pender" was issued in August and was followed by the album No Hay Quinto Malo in October. La Energía Norteña resumed their rigorous touring schedule in 2017 and appeared on the compilations 12 Romanticas con Sax, Vol. 1 and Vol. 2. Before the year's end, the band issued a pre-release YouTube video featuring the title track from El Sueño Americano performed live in the street. In March, "Despedida de Soltera" was issued as an official single; it reached number 28 on the Regional Mexican Airplay chart. 2018's Poco a Poco netted two charting singles in "Te Pido Permiso" and "Ya No Vivo Por Vivir." The following year, A Puro Galope was a collaborative album hosted by La Energía Norteña, who led several other ensembles, including La Furia del Bravo, Sexto Grado, Conjunto Peña Blanca, La Alianza Norteña, and others. It boasted the international radio smash "500 Novillo." Later that year, they followed it with Saquen las Chelas. While the pandemic kept the band from touring, they did issue the charting full-length Diez in October 2020. Two years later, in August 2022, La Energía Norteña delivered the charting, 20-track live offering Viejitas Pero Bonitas, and three months after that, they issued Sesión Acústica. The live sequel Viejitas Pero Bonitas Vol. 2 appeared in April 2023 with 25 tracks. The band followed it with the studio collections Fuera De Serie in May, and Saquen las Chelas, Edición Corridos in September. The live Al Rojo Vivo appeared in May 2024 and was followed by the studio set Gratitud in December. La Energía Norteña issued a pair of long-players in 2025, Pasado, Presente, Futuro and QUINCEANERA; both were chock full of brand-new studio material. Between those offerings, the group released the digital-only concert recording En Vivo Desde Houston, TX. Following a tour, the band entered the studio to collaborate with Grupo Legitimo and released EnerGitimo in April 2026. ~ Jason Birchmeier, Rovi

name: Sunny Sauceda
bio: Sunny Sauceda is a Three-time GRAMMY winner whose music bridges Texas Country swagger with the soul of Tejano and Tex-Mex tradition. Known as much for his fiery accordion licks as for his raw, raspy vocals, Sunny has carved a unique path that blends small-town country roots with the rich cultural soundscape of South Texas.  A Texas Music Awards winner, Tejano Roots Hall of Famer, and lifelong performer since the age of five, Sunny has collaborated across genres—proving that country and conjunto share the same heartbeat of storytelling, family, and pride. His catalog continues to grow with fan favorites like the high-octane anthem Hotsauce, the heartfelt ballad Together Forever, and the romantic two-step Faster Than the Speed of Love. His latest single adds another chapter, showcasing his ability to move seamlessly from fiery dance tracks to timeless love songs.  Whether onstage at the Texas Country Music Awards or at a backyard dance hall in the Rio Grande Valley, Sunny Sauceda brings energy, authenticity, and a voice that connects traditions while blazing new trails. His music is more than a sound—it’s Texas  heritage, country grit, and Tejano fire, all rolled into one.    https://linktr.ee/sunnysauceda

name: Robert Ray
bio: Robert Ray is a rising Texas Country singer and songwriter from Alice, Texas. At just 27 years old, Robert has already released three EP's independently, with five radio singles achieving Top 5 or better on the charts. Four of those singles, “Drunk Enough,” “Two-Steppin’ at a Time,” “Good Country Song,” and “I Found You” hit #1 on the Texas Regional Radio Report Chart, while one single, “Run Away with You”, reached as high as #2 on the TRRR Chart. Robert was recently nominated for “Male Vocalist of the Year” by the Texas Regional Radio Music Awards, as well as “Video of the Year” nominations for “Run Away with You” and “Good Country Song.”  Robert Ray is a 2017 Graduate of Texas A&M University-Kingsville, earning a bachelor's degree in Industrial Management and Technology with a minor in Business Administration. In addition, Robert was recently the recipient of the 2020 “Rising Star Award” by the Texas A&M University Alumni Association.  Robert’s current single “Country on the Radio” is his eleventh single released to radio & the title track to his new album.  His deep South Texas roots continue to keep him true to the traditional ‘old-school’ style of country music with prominent pedal steel and fiddle. His talents have earned him multiple award nominations and grabbed the attention of top-level industry influencers. The culmination of his arduous work, non-stop touring, and radio success have cemented Robert's place at the forefront of the Texas Country Music scene.

name: Juan Cerro
bio: Siempre dudé en sacar mi propia musica, porque no me sentía listo para decir lo que quería decir. No quería sacar musica solo por sacarla y no quería apresurar un proceso creativo para el cual no estaba listo para explorar una narrativa que yo no estaba dispuesto de encontrar en mi.  Prefería a ayudar a otros a encontrar esa voz dentro de ellos :)    Pero el 2022 me dio mil razones para sentir que el momento para poner en canciones propias un mensaje que va mas allá de mi mismo, era el correcto.    Muchas veces nos abrumamos intentando meter un universo entero en nuestras canciones/acciones/metas/planes, pero aprendi que si intento escribir una canción del tamaño de un vaso de agua, podré darme cuenta que con tiempo en ese vaso encuentro un universo entero.
