name: Antonio Roberto
bio: Hailing from the UK, Antonio Roberto is a versatile multi-instrumentalist whose enchanting guitar melodies and mesmerizing piano compositions captivate listeners. With a rich background in crafting recording loops and covers showcased on YouTube over the years, Antonio Roberto now unveils his musical treasures on Spotify, promising an immersive journey through his soulful soundscape.

name: Aron Luna
bio: Aaron Luna is the deep-focus music project of Swedish guitarist and composer Samuel Gajicki. Combining atmospheric electric guitar, subtle heartbeat-like rhythms, and immersive ambient textures, the music is designed to support concentration, creativity, and flow. Minimalist yet emotionally rich, each track creates a calm sonic environment that helps listeners stay focused while working, studying, reading, or reflecting.

name: Lush Hush
bio: Smooth Guitars, Ambient and Lofi Music that's all we do! :)  Lush Hush is a cozy lofi beats collective dedicated to creating warm, comforting soundtracks for everyday moments. Blending soft melodies, mellow rhythms, gentle textures, and dreamy atmospheres, Lush Hush crafts music designed for studying, reading, relaxing, sleeping, and unwinding after a long day.  Inspired by quiet nights, rainy afternoons, and the simple beauty of slowing down, each track creates a peaceful space where listeners can focus, reflect, or simply drift away. Whether you're deep in a study session, curled up with a book, working from home, or preparing for a restful sleep, Lush Hush provides the perfect backdrop for calm and comfort.  With a focus on soothing vibes and timeless lofi aesthetics, Lush Hush invites listeners into a world of warmth, tranquility, and gentle inspiration—one beat at a time.

name: Humasnó
bio: Humasnó makes calming soundscapes with ethereal guitar melodies ✨

name: Far & Beyond
bio: Some brain music for your brainy thoughts

name: Theo Ember
bio: Theo Ember is a quiet exploration of fragile melodies and drifting atmospheres. Built from subtle textures and restrained emotion

name: Aurora Bloom
bio: Auror Bloom  is ambient music built around electric guitar. Lines arrive slowly, pads fill the quiet around them, and a low pulse keeps the floor. It stays in the room without asking to be followed.

name: Winters Dawn
bio: Winters Dawn is an English guitarist creating calm, understated electric guitar music for moments of rest and reflection. Shaped by years of playing and a deep connection to the instrument, the project is a personal outlet for exploring the quieter, more emotional side of the guitar.  Based in England, Winters Dawn focuses on warm tones, simple melodies, and spacious arrangements, drawing attention to the often overlooked ability of the electric guitar to soothe rather than shout. The music is closely tied to ideas of mindfulness and slowing down, offering a gentle soundtrack for unwinding, focus, and presence.

name: Apóge
bio: Painting peaceful landscapes through heartfelt guitar chords.

name: Oblivion
bio: Oblivion is calm, spacious music built from ambient textures and simple guitar lines. It’s made for slowing down, letting thoughts drift, and staying in the moment.

name: Deep Club
bio: The project "Deep Club" moves between deep pulse and restrained atmosphere. Minimal, hypnotic, and immersive. Music made for late hours, focus, and slow inner motion.

name: Semi Sphere
bio: Semi Sphere is a transcontinental duo that was founded in 2021. With a knack for building serene soundscapes and creating musical mood palettes, Semi Sphere delivers the background to any relaxing or meditative experience.

name: Imber Sun
bio: Imber Sun creates atmospheric instrumental music rooted in stillness, emotion, and the beauty of simplicity. Gentle guitar melodies drifting through vast cinematic landscapes.

name: Equilibrium
bio: The music of Equilibrium doesn't demand your attention; it gently cradles it. Through patient looping and soft, reverberant guitar strums, these tracks form a tapestry of calm that sits perfectly in the background of your life.

name: Space Access
bio: Guitarist and producer from Sweden creating melody-driven and atmospheric guitar tracks to help you focus on the things that matter to you.

name: Laurent Emmmerling
bio: Thank you for listening to my music! I make music for sleep and relaxing, meant to quiet the mind and let rest take over.

name: Phil Servati
bio: Phil is a composer and pianist whose music bridges orchestral film scoring and the subtle intimacy of acoustic piano. Rooted in a love for the orchestra and analog synthesizers, his work weaves rich orchestration with expressive melodic writing.  His music can be heard in campaigns for Genesis, Titleist, and Verizon, as well as in films such as Chasing Faster and For the Team.  Alongside his work for film and advertising, he releases music centered on the acoustic piano—simple, spacious pieces built around tone and understated emotion. Shaped by classical training and years of writing for picture, his music balances lyrical piano writing with a strong sense of musical storytelling.

name: M. Ljungström
bio: M. Ljungström is a Swedish pianist and composer known for his calm, evocative piano music. With a focus on simplicity, atmosphere and emotion, his compositions have resonated with listeners all around the world.

name: Michael Rokser
bio: Michael Rokser is a pseudonym used by Nashville-based musician Kevin Gastonguay. His soothing piano soundscapes invite you to relax, take a deep breath, and float along a gentle melodic stream.

name: OIYYIO
bio: Welcome to my sound space, a place where I would like to share many beautiful stories. OIYYIO.

name: Ali Toygar
bio: Hi, this is Ali. I believe that music is the best expression of ourselves. It makes everything alive in our lives. Every note touches the soul. When I started to compose, I felt the soft, deep and lonely side of our presence and it came into existince as music that you can listen to here. I hope that it can touch your beings and resonate with you.   Thanks for tuning in,  Greetings,

name: Gidde
bio: Gidde is one of the solo projects with the Swedish jazzmusician, producer and multi-instrumentalist Andreas Gidlund.

name: Glenn Natale
bio: Expressing with my piano,what cannot be spoken with words.

name: Linior
bio: London based neoclassical composer

name: Nazomi
bio: My mother’s mother always said: 「深い川ほどゆっくり流れる」 — the deeper the river, the slower it flows.

name: Eigil Leuc
bio: Just a piano and a few simple melodies. Thanks for being here.

name: Adrián Úlfur
bio: Adrián Úlfur creates atmospheric piano music shaped by gentle melodies and quiet emotion. His compositions invite the listener into a world of stillness reflection and calm.

name: Matthew L. Fisher
bio: Matthew L. Fisher is an award winning composer for films, games and television. He also produces his own full length solo piano and instrumental albums, which have gained worldwide recognition. He has been involved in a wide variety of different projects ranging from epic scores to soft and subdued music.  ​Matthew's music has been used for some of the biggest campaigns in the world, including STAR WARS: RISE OF SKYWALKER, HOGWARTS LEGACY, DISNEY'S FROZEN 2, AVATAR and much more.  He has also scored theatrically released feature films including TORTURED FOR CHRIST and SABINA which won numerous awards.  Contact Matthew L. Fisher: EMAIL: matthewfishermusic34@gmail.com WEBSITE: matthewfishermusic.com

name: Potting Shed Dreams
bio: For the early mornings and the soft rhythm of time spent growing something fragile.

name: Colias Fieldii
bio: Soft piano melodies blooming into life. Fragile as a pupa, yet vast as the world itself once the wings unfold. Hear the music of a butterfly.

name: Jeremy Mayfield
bio: Bitten by the piano composition bug at the age of 13, Jeremy began his love affair with Music in a little town in the U.S. and has been composing and playing the piano (and several other instruments) ever since. His music has been described as “magical”, “cinematic”, “visceral”, and “instantly evocative”, even from his earliest days writing songs 30 years ago. A classically trained pianist with a B.A. in Music, Jeremy is well-versed in NeoClassical, Jazz, New Age, Ambient, Country, and Pop, and feels right at home in nearly any genre. He has a growing global fan base, and his songs have been featured on multiple editorial playlists, including “Peaceful Piano” with over 7.6 million followers. He now calls Nashville, Tennessee home, where he wears many musical hats (on his shiny, bald head!) including Composer, Arranger, Session Musician, Teacher, Live Musician, and Producer. Of all the hats Jeremy wears, he’s most proud to wear the ones called “Husband” to his beautiful wife, Whitney, and “Father” to his four ridiculously cute kids.

name: Hiroco.M
bio: Hiroko Murakami (Hiroco.M) began to play classical piano when she was 3 years old and continued until today. In University she studied musical composition and piano meanwhile she performed in music salons every night in Ginza, and sometimes on cruises ship. It was around that time that she started composing her first album.   Hiroko focuses on intimate and warm sound recorded on a soft upright piano, in doing so, she tries to offer each listener a personal experience of her performance.

name: Hiroko Murakami
bio: Japanese composer and pianist known as Hiroco.M (main spotify profile)

name: Güel Mipér
bio: https://miguelperez.es/

name: Dwight Rivera
bio: Dwight Rivera is a Los Angeles based pianist, composer, and musical director. Originally from New York City, he’s a graduate of Berklee College of Music with a dual Bachelor’s Degree in Film Scoring and Contemporary Writing/Production. Dwight attended Fiorello H. LaGuardia High School, where he joined the school’s New Music Ensemble, a composition collective known as one of the foremost popular music composition seminars in the country. While there he developed a passion for working with and supporting singers. He was also encouraged by teacher Robert Apostle to start composing solo piano music.  Since moving to Los Angeles, Dwight has kept up a busy career as a keyboardist, session player, accompanist, and Musical Director. He has played and worked with musicians, singers, and actors such as Joss Stone, Linda Perry, Colin Hay (Men at Work), Sheryl Lee Ralph, Elliot Yamin, Pia Toscano, Tito Puente Jr, world music superstar Khaled, and many others. He has toured as a keyboardist across the country and internationally.  In recent years Dwight has added a focus on solo piano and instrumental music. His compositions are enjoyed by millions across the globe daily. Dwight’s piano music focuses on beautiful, elegant melodies accompanied by intimate, peaceful ostinatos that convey a sense of tranquility and nostalgia for anyone who listens.

name: San Fiore
bio: It’s already in the name: I love Sun, Flowers, Happiness, Light. And of course, I invite you to be part of it; because life’s better together, isn’t it?! So come and join in on the good vibes. Take off your shoes, walk barefoot through the sand, if you like it grab my hand, and stroll along.   San Fiore is living a van life, often close to the beach. Whenever she finds an instrument, she starts to play, and a bond sprouts between her and the instrument. A simple digital piano in the van works alright, but acoustic pianos are the real thing with a real vibe. Do you have a piano to play? Make sure to let people know, and San Fiore, or someone alike, will soon come and lift the spirits in your place for sure!

name: Blake Hollow
bio: Blake Hollow is my most stripped-down piano project. Recorded with minimal distance between hands, strings, and room, the music allows small noises, breathing, and imperfections to remain. These are small human pieces, written quietly and meant for still spaces.

name: Biba Dupont
bio: Hi!  We are Helga Blanco and Xalo Gayoso, two composers and piano performers. Since 2010 we've been working in different projects (Sub Rosa, Birdhub and now Biba Dupont), also composing for film and multimedia. With our current Project, Biba Dupont, we are exploring the connections between minimal piano textures and electronic soundscapes, emotional landscapes with a strong rhythmic pattern and club feeling, always focusing in the organic side of the music.

name: Sulman Indigo
bio: ARTISTVERIFICATION_BENARN220720260949

name: Kuro Yama
bio: Solo piano, no extra layers. I let the melody do the talking.

name: Moldoveanu
bio: From time steeped in the beauty of nature, piano melodies have captured my imagination. I hope you enjoy what you hear.

name: Leon Hartness
bio: Up in the North, it is so quiet that you can hear the sounds — sounds that want to speak, sounds that want to tell the story of those who came before us.

name: Shreyas Murali
bio: Shreyas Murali is a pianist, composer, and songwriter based near New York, USA with a diverse background in both classical piano and jazz performance. He focuses his composition work on combining and evolving the sensory colors of musicians such as Debussy, Chopin, and Eldar into various genres. With a growing portfolio as a session pianist and composer for productions including those with C. Sathya and Bombay Jayashri, he looks to be part of a future of global, cross-genre collaborations with both pioneering and established musicians.

name: Franz Gordon
bio: With millions of monthly listeners worldwide, Franz Gordon weaves timeless influences into a captivating sound. Drawing inspiration from the rich heritage of classical music, Franz Gordon blends elegant melodies with a modern sensibility, creating a distinctive and immersive experience. Critics celebrate Franz Gordon for a unique blend of tradition and innovation, offering listeners a journey that feels both familiar and refreshingly new. For many, stepping into Franz Gordon’s music is like entering another world, a space where the past and present harmonize beautifully. In moments of creative flow, it’s like an intimate dance, guiding listeners through a captivating journey.

name: Spring Bunny
bio: Music for slowing down

name: Alaskan Tapes
bio: Toronto-based composer Alaskan Tapes, a.k.a. Brady Kendall, has quietly architected a prolific catalog with an intense attention to detail. Striking a balance between ambient alchemy, poignant string arrangements, and unexpected guitar conjurations, he continues to forge uncharted territory. Generating north of 100 million streams and enthralling audiences, he only widens the scope of his dynamic vision on his 2023 full- length album, Who Tends a Garden. The new record explores the metaphorical and literal meaning of a garden, whether it’s composed of sound or of the dirt in one’s yard. The concept for the garden theme came to him in an old bookstore on a trip to the Adirondack Mountains in New York, where he came across the book, Who Loves A Garden by Louise Seymour Jones, a title from 1935 filled with old poems and essays on the subject. His musical DNA may encompass everything from heavy metal to drum ‘n’ bass, but all of these elements eventually filtered into one focus. During 2015, he introduced Alaskan Tapes with Beyond the Streets followed by We All Speak in Poems [2016] In Distance We’re Losing [2017], You Were Always an Island [2018], Millions [2020], Views from Sixteen Stories [2020], and For Us Alone [2021]. Along the way, “Notes” eclipsed 28 million Spotify streams, with “Views from Tower Two” amassing 20 million Spotify streams—unprecedented numbers for ambient music. He has also contributed to various films and soundtracks.

name: Jerome Louis
bio: Jerome Louis is a neoclassical pianist and composer whose music blends classical influences with elements of film and contemporary music. Through expressive melodies and atmospheric harmonies, he creates intimate piano pieces that invite listeners into a world of reflection and imagination.  From an early age, Jerome developed a deep connection with music and discovered inspiration in composers such as Mozart and Chopin, alongside influences from popular and jazz music. Over the years, this broad musical background evolved into a personal style where emotion and melody always take center stage.  Inspired by nature, memories and everyday moments, Jerome Louis creates music that feels both timeless and cinematic — resonating with listeners looking for peace, emotion and stories without words.

name: Polly Carter
bio: Polly Carter is a pianist, artist, and composer from the UK. Her work is inspired by natural themes which imbue her style with a sense of peace.

name: Luis Berra
bio: My melodies are born in the fields where I played as a child, later losing myself in the alleys and bridges of Florence until reaching the sea and slowly ascending the hills of the Maremma, among the olive trees and vineyards, where wolves still run wild. And then off again, from the Arno to the Danube, far away, toward the Bavarian forests, where the roads are crossed by somnambulistic roe deer and flocks of travelling birds. Playing the Blues from the Rocky mountains to the Faroe Islands, and getting lost in the middle of Europe in a Bach choral or in a Beethoven Sonata, always ready for  new improvisations. In the silences of magical places and encounters with special creatures, in the nostalgia and memories that embrace the joy of discovery, at home and around the world. All those places were the backdrop to writing these pieces of music and life that are my stories.  Don’t forget to write yours. I’m sure that each, in its own way, will be splendid.  Maybe we’ll play them one day, on a beach or perhaps in a small trattoria in some remote hillside village.   For any information please contact luisberrapiano@gmail.com

name: Arata Rin
bio: New York City based composer and pianist

name: Keane Wang
bio: Pianist and composer Matthew-Keane Wang (AKA Kainbeats)'s first experience playing music for others was in a retirement home where he wrote pieces of solo piano music for elderly residents with Alzheimer's and dementia. It was called 'Music for Memories' and the musical link helped them remember a precious memory. Years later during a health crisis of his own, he changed from medical school to music full-time. Writing music inspired by faith, soundtrack and the beauty of everyday life, he found a way to heal through sound. His inspirations range from neoclassical artists like Ludovico Einaudi and Max Richter to soundtrack composers like Secret Garden and Akira Kosemura whom he had the opportunity to work with, and Saigenji. His most recent projects Pacific Lull, Lavender Dreams, and Dryad's Hymn raised over £28,000 for ocean conservation, bee re-habitation, and enclosures for animal victims of poaching. His compositions are featured on platforms such as Apple's iOS (iPhone), Discord, and Epic Games.

name: Lisa Kriegler
bio: Lisa Kriegler (7 November 1999) is a pianist based in Germany (Mainz), with a passion for Classical Music. Fitting with her character, she loves classical beauty. Whether it is in music, arts, architecture, nature or cars: her love for details and beauty cannot seize. To Lisa, beauty is arguably inseparable from goodness and purity. Values she tries to live by every day. Values she tries to express through her musical pieces also. Lisa started taking piano lessons at the age of 8, and never really stopped. It didn’t take long before her talent got discovered and ever since then she’s got some great opportunities offered to get her music heard. On public stages, that is. However, she’d rather reach out to the world in a different, more anonymous way. Out of sight. Starting off in 2022, Lisa Kriegler her songs have found a broad audience, reaching over 10 million streams all over the world.

name: Gavin Luke
bio: ***SHEET MUSIC AVAILABLE AT GAVINLUKE.COM***    Gavin Luke is a composer and producer whose music draws from his passion for classical music, film scores, and electronica. Adept at depicting life in all its fragility and resiliency, Gavin’s music has resonated with millions of fans throughout the world. Many of Gavin’s compositions have been heard over 30 million times on Spotify and several billion times on YouTube.    From an early age, Gavin was innately drawn to the musical world. At age 7 he began taking classical piano lessons, following in the footsteps of both his parents and his grandmother. Throughout his childhood, Gavin both practiced and experimented with classical masterpieces, frequently re-writing the works of renowned composers such as Brahms and Mozart. This creative flair continued through his education as he played in numerous bands, whilst familiarizing himself with the nuances of film scores and music production.   Today, Gavin spends his time composing for Epidemic Sound, artists and visual media. In 2022, Gavin scored the music for the documentary "The Noble Guardian" which went on to win best documentary at the 2023 L.A. Shorts Intl. Film Festival and is now available on Amazon Prime.

name: Lou Maxence
bio: Hailing from France, Lou Maxence approaches the piano with a painter’s touch and a poet’s heart. His melodies are intimate conversations—capturing the fragility of memory and the beauty of fleeting moments. With each delicate phrase, he invites listeners into a world of quiet elegance and French sensibility.

name: Clemens Christian Poetzsch
bio: Clemens Christian Poetzsch is a German pianist and composer whose music moves between contemporary classical music, jazz, and electronic music. His music is rooted in the piano, while leaving room for other sounds and unexpected directions.  He has released six solo albums and performed internationally, including solo concerts at the Elbphilharmonie in Hamburg and the Philharmonic in Brno. Alongside his own projects, he works as a composer, pianist, and arranger, writing music for film, theater, and ballet.  His latest solo album, NOCTUNES, was released in October 2026. Inspired by places he has encountered while touring, the album reflects on the feeling of being somewhere after dark. It offers his personal take on the tradition of the nocturne.

name: Elliott Jack Sansom
bio: Music, to me, isn’t just about telling stories - it’s my medicine, my mindfulness.  It finds you in the chaos, catches you off guard, and leaves you with something you didn’t know you needed.  Maybe that’s what my songs can be for you:  a little glow in the dark, a pause in the noise, or just a melody to carry with you.  Thank you for letting me share it with you!  Find my sheet music here: www.elliottjacksansom.com

name: April Baxter
bio: Hi, my name is April and I am aUK based Composer who loves writing for piano and strings. Thank you for listening and spending time with me and my music. Please direct all enquiries to my label Modern Classical X.  modernclassicalx.com

name: Julia Andersson
bio: Finnish-Swedish pianist and composer Julia Andersson writes instrumental music that weaves together contemporary classical, jazz, and ambient influences. Combining delicate piano melodies with rich, atmospheric harmonies, her music offers a quiet invitation to pause, breathe, and reconnect with the world around us. Classically trained from the age of nine, Andersson discovered improvisation in her early twenties, transforming her relationship with the piano. Today, she creates music shaped by intuition, deep listening and the quiet rhythms of Nordic nature. Following her independent debut EP Within, without (2020), she began collaborating with Canadian label Moderna Records. Her releases, including the debut album Dröm (2023), have reached millions of listeners worldwide and led to performances across Finland, Sweden, Germany, Belgium and Portugal. Her second album, set to release in October 2026, is her most personal work to date. Forever the Forest Sings is an intimate collection recorded in her home studio in Helsinki, reflecting the many subtle shifts that shape our inner and outer lives. Moving through moments of stillness, uncertainty, longing, warmth and change, the album embraces the fluctuations of life and invites each listener to find their own stories within.

name: Norman Dück
bio: Norman Dück is a classically-trained multi-instrumentalist and recording artist.  He works in various genres under different Artist-names. Since 2018 he has also been writing orchestral music for TV and film exclusively.

name: Charly Martin
bio: I write piano melodies here and release neo-classical music as Wings for Louise. I used to DJ and produce some electronics as Echo 6. I also create some ambient soundscapes with modular synths.

name: Garreth Broke
bio: Garreth Broke’s music explores what it means to be human in a harsh but beautiful world.  He has been composing music since his early teens. What began as a source of pleasure became an escape during a crisis that consumed his family when his mother faced a severe battle with depression, culminating in a suicide attempt.  After studying music at the University of Oxford, he began collaborating with German contemporary artist Anna Salzmann on a series of works that combined music and art, using the pen name Garreth Broke.  Since then, he has released music with 1631 Recordings, Bigo & Twigetti, THESIS, and Moderna Records. His music has received airplay from BBC Radio 3, KEXP, and NTS, and he has shared the stage with musicians including Hania Rani, Clemens Christian Poetzsch, and Simeon Walker.  His latest album, Life Through Loss, will be released in September 2025 on the renowned German label Neue Meister. Deeply informed by Garreth’s personal experience of bereavement and his work as a volunteer ‘Trauerbegleiter’ (grief companion), the album offers a nuanced exploration of grief in all its complexity—embracing both pain and hope. Through evocative piano compositions, Garreth distills not only his own evolving grief for his mother but also the shared stories of those he has accompanied through loss. Life Through Loss stands as a compassionate and insightful tribute to anyone who has experienced grief, inviting listeners to find solace and meaning within their own journeys.

name: Jacopo Croci
bio: Italian composer, born in Como, he lived in Milan and now he lives in Alba. He plays piano since he was 6 years old. He graduated in 2016 at Conservatory G. Verdi of Milan in Composition. Still in Milan he graduated in Music for Films at Civic Academy C. Abbado. He worked in Roberto Cacciapaglia’s studio as musical assistant. He composes musics for short films, documentaries and plays, too: his biggest collaborations was with the theater Accademia P. Grassi. He also used to compose for orchestra: his composition “Un Homme de Tetes” has been performed in 2018 in Hastings (U.K.) at the International Composers Festival. He wrote a book to learn playing piano, published by Sinfonica at the end of 2021. His music is the result of many types of music: from classical to soundtrack, from minimalism to blues and pop nuances. His debut was on November 2017 with “Souvenirs”, it’s from 2021 under the label “Believe Music” . He reached 7 millions streams on Spotify, 2 millions on Apple Music and just reached 12 millions streams in general . The leading actor of his compositions is piano, sometimes matched by electronics.

name: Luca Mazzillo
bio: Luca Mazzillo is a composer, pianist, and producer based in Rome, Italy, known for his evocative works in the Modern Classical genre.  Luca’s music tells stories, blending emotion and narrative through sound. He has released six albums: Lifewalk, an intimate and personal exploration; Il Viaggiatore e l’Imperatore, inspired by literature; Flares, a reflection on nature and climate change; Two Lives, a journey through the duality of existence and the pursuit of dreams; 1711, an introspective collection that captures life’s complexities and nostalgic childhood memories; and "My Universe", an intimate and cinematic journey through the vastness of time, self, and existence.  In addition to his albums, Luca shares a new musical story nearly every month—a single piece inspired by a moment, sensation, or memory. With numerous collaborations and exciting projects on the horizon, Luca continues to expand his creative universe.  Discover more at luca.mazzillo.com or contact him at info@lucamazzillo.com.

name: Jens Larsson
bio: Jens Larsson is a pianist, composer and producer from Sweden.  He makes  emotional and beautiful instrumental music in the genre Neo classical, New Age and jazz.  He has produced  instrumental music for tv and series.  His songs has been placed in Tv all over the world.  Shows like: Geronimo Stilton, Project Runway allstars, Comedians in cars,  Åndenes makt, Arga snickaren, Newton and many more.  He has worked for years being a musical leader in shows,  He has played with many great scandinavian  artists over the years like:

name: Galen Rise
bio: Galen Rise creates music that flows like a gentle river, with minimalist piano compositions that are both soothing and meditative. The pieces provide a peaceful sonic landscape for relaxation, offering listeners a quiet moment to retreat from the noise of daily life.

name: Skye High
bio: What can I say… There’s a lot. And at the same time nothing in particular. I’m just a guy who lives and breathes music, I guess. Music being the purest manifestation of nature, if you ask me. An infinite source of oxygen. Intangible as well. And yes, I find them healing, these notes floating by, sometimes bundled as chords, changing their form into a new harmony with every beat. Like clouds, slowly but surely drifting towards the sun. Yeasty clouds, holding a promise. Colorful clouds, free to come and go, whenever and wherever suits them. On their own journey pursuing new horizons.   Ever since I was a kid, I’ve been enchanted by the idea of transcending my restless body by letting my mind fully align with them clouds. And then of course there’s the – what again…? Don’t remember where I was heading to, but who does anyway. Who knows where to go really in life? And…  what does it matter. Let go. Let the music take you as high as the sky. And don’t forget to enjoy the view.

name: Serge Dusault
bio: Dutch composer/pianist Serge Dusault started his studio (Black Oak Studio) back in 2014 and has been producing and recording tracks for various artists ever since. The year 2020 marked the beginning of producing and releasing songs under his own name. After many years of performing live with several bands he now found his way back to his roots: minimalistic, moody piano pieces, backed up by synths and ambient electronics.

name: Hans Bukowski
bio: With delicate keys and soothing melodies, this pianist creates a peaceful soundscape for a tranquil state of mind.

name: Michael Frankenberger
bio: Michael Frankenberger is an Austrian film composer and classical artist, whose music is defined by emotional clarity, expressive storytelling, and a refined sense of harmony. He is known for his work Kennedy (History Channel), Mind over Matter (Servus TV), Stable (BBC | Main Theme by Lorne Balfe), Salzburg. Eine Kunstgeschichte, We Shall Not Die Now (Main Theme by Benjamin Wallfisch), Bang on Time (RedBull), and his solo albums Love Letters, Healing & In Silentio. With more than 40 Million Streams on Spotify, he has emerged as one of the most listened-to young classical Artists. In recognition of his artistic achievements, Michael was named to the prestigious Forbes 30 under 30 List in 2020. Michael has been writing and arranging additional music under Grammy-winner by Lorne Balfe and on over a dozen Projects including Gran Turismo, Steven Spielberg´s Primetime Emmy nominated Life on Our Planet (Netflix), and it´s follow-up series The Dinosaurs (Netflix), His Dark Materials (HBO/BBC), Man Vs. Bee (Netflix) and Doctor Who Spin-off The War Between the Land and the Sea (Disney / BBC). Having spent a few years working with 14th Street Music, which was founded by Lorne Balfe and Hans Zimmer, Michael had the chance to gain a vast experience on various projects and styles in his early twenties on several films and over 65 Episodes of TV Series. Michael studied Composition (BA) and Music Theory (BA) at the worldwide renowned University of Mozarteum in Salzburg.

name: Jozef De Schutter
bio: Based in Switzerland, pianist and composer Jozef De Schutter creates intimate contemporary piano music inspired by silence, light and stillness. His music has been streamed more than 100 million times worldwide, offering listeners a quiet space for reflection, presence and calm. Each composition reveals the beauty of simplicity and the poetry of everyday moments.  📷 Katya Kalyska

name: Christian Janssen
bio: Christian Janssen is a Dutch neo-classical pianist and composer passionate about making a meaningful contribution to this world. He was brought up in an environment where he got to make loads of music. He started off as a self-taught organist, already composing small pieces of music when he reached the age of seven. One day Christian decided to switch to piano after having a dream that felt like a revelation. A vision where he spreads peace through music still inspires him to this day. As he spent every weekend of his youth in churches, performing with churchbands and choirs, Christian takes a lot of inspiration from his faith. His sound is best described not only as peaceful but also heartfelt. Sincere with a soothing beat. Every song can be considered a story. Over a period of roughly two decades, Christian has evolved into a versatile musician who’s always searching for ways to make a meaningful contribution to this world. One way or another. Whether it is by composing a piano piece for people with Alzheimer’s disease, playing the piano in a children’s hospital or performing at the local homeless centre to get a smile on people’s faces. He experiences great value in sharing his music as much as he can. Starting off his career as a solo pianist in 2022, Christian Janssen reached 17,5 million plays within a year. He has a long history with music. Christian has his own playlist: Christian piano music and features in Piano Flow - Reading / Studying / Focus / Background.

name: Allysium
bio: Hi, thanks for stopping by. Here I have composed some of my most heartfelt melodies. I hope you enjoy listening to them as much as I enjoy sharing them with you.  -Allysium

name: Carluccio
bio: In the busyness of life, what I often most need is some time at my piano. It is here where I can regain my center and begin to find a sense of peace and tranquility. Perhaps it can do the same for you. Thanks for tuning in.

name: Følgesvend
bio: I write simple piano tunes that help me slow down, and I hope they do the same for others. Just a few quiet minutes, a simple melody, and a place where thoughts can settle.

name: Marco Apicella
bio: Los Angeles based pianist, composer, and producer Marco Apicella is an artist of liminal spaces, weaving together classical, jazz and pop in his music. His delicate cinematic sonic landscapes invite listeners on enchanting journeys that evoke sensitivity, playfulness and movement.    A native of Rome, Italy and classically trained pianist, Apicella distinguished himself by gaining diverse experiences, performing as a Jazz artists and keyboard player all around Europe and America beginning in 2013. His technical musical skill set earned him international performance opportunities with the likes of Bernard Fowler of The Rolling Stones, the 2 time Grammy Award winner Marcus Miller and 3 times Grammy Award-Winning funk group Snarky Puppy.   In the following years, he relocated to Los Angeles to complete a Doctorate of Musical Arts among the esteemed faculty of University of Southern California. Apicella continues to break the stereotypes around the classical genre, innovating through the yoking together of his Jazz background with minimalist ethereal sounds, giving nods to classical giants such as Debussy, while embracing Herbie Hancock's unpredictability.   His vulnerability matches his technical ability as he harkens to his many musical influences who each bear their mark of inspiration in his genre bending work. The ripple effects of Apicella's musical waves are far reaching, and it seems that they have just begun.

name: Tom Kristiaan
bio: “When I touch the keys, I dream myself away to another world.” Tom Kristiaan is a pianist and neoclassical composer from Belgium. From his home in the countryside near Bruges, he creates dreamy melodies that resonate with listeners worldwide. His music is sensitive, gentle, intimate, and delicate, often wrapped in a veil of melancholy.  His compositions have been featured on television and radio, and his third album, Petites Danses et Rêveries, was nominated for the prestigious Edison Awards, alongside renowned artists Max Richter and Hans Zimmer.  “I’m a great lover of nature. Walking or running along the winding roads near my home relaxes me, much like playing the piano. When I touch the keys, I dream myself away to another world,” he says.  Thank you for listening. It's a pleasure to share my dreams and emotions to you.  More info / sheet music: www.tomkristiaan.com

name: Erjos
bio: I love nature. In it I find balance, strength and inspiration to create my music. I believe that between nature and music there is a continuity that determines both to be part of human life.  contact : dario.crisman@virgilio.it

name: James Quinn
bio: I am James Quinn, thanks for finding me. I was born in Scotland some time ago; my father was a farmer and my mother a bank clerk in a small fishing town. Growing up in the countryside, I always loved nature and think this inspired my music. Even today I spend as much time as possible exploring the Scottish Highlands. At school I enjoyed maths and music, ultimately studying engineering at university which became my mainstay. I never stopped writing music and frequently share my latest compositions here. Recently "A Gentle Sunlight" had a sudden burst of interest which caught me by surprise. It means a lot that you're here listening and that people are using my music as they share their own stories. bio: Edvard Kravchuk is a Ukrainian composer and pianist with over 100 million streams worldwide. He began playing the piano and violin at the age of six and graduated from the National Music Academy of Ukraine as a composer. His works are often performed by symphony orchestras and soloists around the world. The single Momentary was chosen for the film Red, White & Royal Blue. In 2018 he releases two cinematic albums Time for Action аnd Sotto Voce . In 2019 he returns to solo piano and released the single Look Up to the Sky which entered the best Spotify playlists and gained more than 3 million streams. In April 2020, he released the album L. I.. Y... and got 10.000.000 streams in six months. The album's lead single Look Inside Yourself has over 30 million streams. Sometimes he writes songs Beneath Your Sky December 2020, the new album "In itself" is released, which includes successful singles My Only One and Moment of Silence . In 2023, he released the album pianissimo and the single "sweetheart" has over 15 million streams. He keeps creating music that plays on the very strings of your soul. You can download the sheet music using the link in Instagram or write me a few kind words. Contact -- edvardkravchuk@gmail.com

name: Thomas Klak
bio: 🎹🎼  sheetmusic available on bandcamp 🎶🎹  Hi, I’m Thomas. I write melancholic, melodic piano pieces for anyone who likes to slow down for a moment.  My music often begins with a mood, a thought, or a sound I can’t let go of — usually turning into a melody that sticks with me and hopefully with you too.  I love following these little emotional trails and shaping them into something you can listen to, breathe with, or drift away to.  If you enjoy intimate, reflective piano music, I’m happy to have you along for the journey.

name: Ron Adelaar
bio: “I begin playing purely by feeling and allow my intuition to guide me from the first notes on the piano, naturally leading to the unfolding of a musical piece.”  Dutch pianist and composer Ron Adelaar creates music straight from emotion and intuition. Ron is also co-founder of the Amsterdam-based label Andante Piano, supporting and guiding emerging piano artists.  Born in 1960 in Amersfoort, The Netherlands, Ron began improvising at a young age while playing organ and piano in local churches. That spontaneous and honest way of creating music still forms the foundation of his work today.  Inspired by silence, nature, family, love, hope, and reflection, his neoclassical piano music invites listeners to slow down and reconnect with themselves. Many of his pieces are recorded in a single take, preserving the emotion exactly as it was felt in that moment.  A major source of inspiration became his journeys on the Camino, walking for many weeks and hundreds of kilometers to Santiago de Compostela. The rhythm of walking and the space for reflection deeply influenced both his life and music.  Influenced by Stephan Moccio, Nils Frahm and Ólafur Arnalds, Ron’s music blends intimacy, atmosphere, and storytelling into a deeply personal listening experience.  With 275 million streams worldwide, his music has become a source of calm, reflection, and emotional connection for listeners around the world.  📷 Photography: Marie van der Heijden ✉️ Contact: ronadelaarmusic@gmail.com

name: Daigo Hanada
bio: Hi music lovers!  Thanks so much for listening to my music :)  東京出身のアーティスト・音楽家。  これまで「作曲家」という肩書きには距離を感じてきました。 音楽理論もコードもわからず、楽譜も読めません。それでも僕のなかではいつも音楽が鳴っています。 旋律だけでなく、すべての楽器の繊細な音色や空気の揺れ、重なり合うレイヤーまで、すべてが完成形として響いています。 僕にとって音楽は、作品づくりというよりも、絶え間なくつづく呼吸や、頭のなかで存在している音たちとの毎日の会話の延長にあるもの、と感じています。  書くのではなく、すでに鳴っている音を実際に形にする、そのような形で「曲づくり」をしています。   ２３才から独学でピアノを習得。  これまでに Spotifyの海外で最も再生された日本人アーティストTop 10(2019)、ビルボードチャート US Top 20に１３週連続チャートイン(2024)など、国内外で高い評価を得ている。  2025年、ドイツから生まれ故郷である東京都へ拠点を移し、音楽家としての第二章をスタート。

name: Josh Kramer
bio: Josh Kramer is a composer and pianist with roots in Ohio and Minnesota, and currently resides in Budapest. His music has been used in productions around the world including numerous tv spots, films, advertisements and commercials for the likes of Chevy, Burberry and others. As a huge fan of artists like Olafur Arnalds, Josh was honored to have his music used in a series of major ballet performances entitled "Escaping the Weight of Darkness" at the National Theatre of Japan in Tokyo which premiered his music alongside Olafur Arnalds and Nils Frahm. Most recently, his song "Light in the Shadows" was featured by Burberry in their advertising campaign for The Kingdom collection. New projects and developments include his score for the upcoming short film "The Wagon", original music for the feature film "The Wake of Light", and the soundtrack for the acclaimed indie game "The First Tree", available on major consoles now.   Switching to first person now. Much of my music is emotional, sensitive and melancholy and stems from tumultuous times in my life in which music was the ultimate catharsis and creative outlet. In a world increasingly fraught with so many issues and uncertainty, it is my hope that my music can serve not only as a temporary refuge and escape from our often chaotic society, but also be a source of inspiration and creativity.

name: Benjamin Dobbs
bio: In the beginning I didn't write these Cristmas piano pieces with any particular intention. They appeared gradually over the years, often in quiet hours when the house was still and there was time to listen a little more carefully.I've always believed music doesn't need many notes to say something true. A simple phrase, played slowly, can carry more than a complicated one played fast. That's the feeling I return to when I sit down at the piano.These days I write mostly for the pleasure of staying close to the instrument and seeing what remains after everything unnecessary is left out. The pieces are small, but they hold time inside them in a way I still find surprising.

His experience performing in various well-known projects gradually shaped a distinct musical voice, rooted in classical tradition yet deeply connected to the present moment.  His music reflects a love for beauty, an admiration for life, and an ability to listen to silence — a space from which sound is born. Melancholy and gentle sadness unfold into acceptance, while calmness and passion, love and loss coexist and lead to new emotional states.  Alex Shimansky’s music leaves room for interpretation, inviting each listener to hear something personal and discover their own meaning.  Contact: alexandrshimansky@gmail.com

name: Finn Laurent
bio: Finn Laurent grew up learning piano the way most kids learn to talk - through listening, imitation, and slow accumulation of instinct. Trained from childhood in the Suzuki method, he absorbed music before he could fully explain it, internalizing tone and phrasing as a kind of mother tongue. That foundation never left. His compositions carry the patience of classical technique but land somewhere quieter and more intimate. Solo piano pieces that feel less like performances and more like thoughts being worked out in real time. There's structure underneath, but you feel the breath in it. Based between studios and wherever he can find a good piano, Finn writes music for the spaces between things: early mornings, long drives, the tail end of a hard week. His catalog is built for headphones and unhurried listening.

I usually play drums in my everyday musical life, but l've always been fascinated by the piano and curious about its ability to create calm, space, and emotion. Returning to the piano feels like slowing down and listening in a different way.  I make music that can be listened to closely or simply exist in the background. Its meant to accompany slow mornings, late evenings, or moments that things need to feel a little lighter.  I'm grateful to be able to share this music with you!

Rooted in epic instrumental soundscapes, Nomad Spector creates music designed to guide listeners away from distraction and into a state of sustained flow.   Blending soaring melodies, driving rhythms, and layered atmospheric guitars, each track unfolds like a journey-building from subtle tension to full intensity. The sound is immersive yet purposeful, crafted to enhance concentration, endurance, and creative momentum.  Nomad Spector's music is made for those who build, create, and push limits. Whether you're deep in a late-night work session, training at your peak, or searching for clarity in motion, the music acts as a silent force keeping you locked in, moving forward. This isn't just music. It's a tool for focus. A catalyst for flow. A soundtrack for momentum.

Drawing inspiration from the unknown and the infinite, the music moves beyond traditional structure-floating between ambient, post-rock, and experimental spaces. Each piece unfolds like a journey through sound, where melody and texture intertwine to evoke a sense of weightlessness and quiet intensity.   Without words, Änge communicates through tone and space, inviting listeners to explore inner and outer worlds alike. The result is a cinematic listening experience - music that resonates somewhere between the earthbound and the cosmic.

name: Anthony Jacobus
bio: It’s late in the evening. The day slowly comes to rest. In the quiet, my thoughts begin to wander — gently slowing down as my breathing finds its rhythm.  I sit at the piano. Soft, unhurried melodies appear, reflecting my mood, my feelings, and the moment itself. Gratitude and joy flow through the notes, sometimes touched by sadness. That is life — full of contrast, light and shadow, highs and lows.  I feel deeply grateful for the ability to express these emotions through music. Even more so to share these piano pieces with listeners around the world. Music has a way of connecting us, beyond language or distance.  My hope is that these peaceful piano compositions offer you a place to slow down — to relax, to focus, or simply to be present while studying, working, or resting.  Enjoy listening. With love, Anthony

name: Sebastián Voyage
bio: Sebastian Voyage's musical journey began at a young age when he first laid hands on the piano. His initial encounter with music was quite emotional – his mom took him to his first piano lesson, and he was in tears before and after. However, something magical happened during that hour-long lesson; his tearful expression transformed into pure fascination, and he fell head over heels in love with the instrument. Growing up, Sebastian delved into the classical styles of pianists from earlier eras and explored the works of contemporary composers like Ludovico Einaudi, Yann Tiersen, and Steve Reich. Drawing inspiration from these influences, he eventually carved out his own unique musical path through composition. Today, Sebastian thrives as a skilled composer, producer, and performer. His unconventional approach to the time-honored piano is both contemplative and intimate, offering listeners an immersive experience that invites them to appreciate the piano in new and diverse ways.   Sebastian Voyage is the pseudonym used by Nazareno (b. 1999) for this project he is definitely not Klaüs :)

15. is the name of the Rotterdam-based neo-classical composer Dylan Viset. In the middle of the crowded city, Viset creates calm, intimate and heartfelt compositions. Collected thoughts and emotions he leaves in the keys of his piano to process the ebb and flow of life.    Growing up in an ambiance of a wide variety of music, Viset became inspired to play the piano at a young age. The love for different genres allowed him to become more electronic-oriented when he got older and soon enough he found himself studying Electronic Producing. Viset has always had an ambition to write music for film and worked with several directors and companies like Bertil Nilsson, MassiveMusic, Nowness and the VPRO for short films and commercials. After all these years of searching and developing his musical identity, he one day sat behind his piano again and started to play. Just play. Nothing more, nothing less. And it felt like coming home.   In October 2019 Viset released his first composition as 15. called “While/Asleep” followed by his second single “Distant” in January 2020. Later this year he got signed by Maestro Music, a sublabel by ADA Music/Warner Music and released his third single ‘Luna’ which was streamed for over a million times in the first three months and was added to several playlists by Spotify, Andante Piano and Double J Music. With all releases he reached a total of 15 million streams worldwide.   On the 4th of March, he released his eight single ‘Supine’

name: Chris Tolley
bio: Based in Scotland, he is known internationally as a television and film composer, with original scores across a diverse range of projects for mainstream programming. In 2019 he released his debut album, 'Beneath the Surface', which was written as a form of therapy in direct response to his mother's cancer diagnosis. The album continues to appear on mindfulness, meditation and focus playlists on radio stations around the world. Herald Scotland named it as one of their albums of the year in 2019, describing it as 'engagingly cinematic'.  His second album, 'Home', was released in 2021 and was inspired largely by the Scandinavian 'Hygge' sensibility. It was written for solo piano and has already gained a large audience because of its warmth and calming vibe in a period where people are looking for comfort more than ever.

name: Jordi Forniés
bio: Jordi Forniés is a Spanish musician, composer, and visual artist based in Australia. His works are characterised by a continuum between tender overarching refrains and defined sequences with increasing momentum. Always contemplative and expansive in nature, his compositions draw on neoclassical and ambient electronic music. Forniés composes for piano, strings, and small ensembles, working with studio recordings alongside electronic elements.   A classically trained pianist since childhood, educated at Conservatorio Profesional de Música de Vila-seca in Spain, Forniés returned to music study in 2017 gaining an MFA in Music Composition and Orchestration at Chichester University in the UK. He is a member of the Composers Society of Singapore.  He has often worked in collaboration with others including Bouvaque with photographer and filmmaker Han Sungpil for which Forniés’ created a piano and string quartet score. He has composed for films including Caroline Fink’s epic documentary about the receding of the largest glacier in Switzerland, Aletsch: Of Ice and Men, 2016, and made music for documentaries and video installations with Gitta Gsell. He also worked on Yan Wang Preston’s major project Mother River, which was exhibited at the Venice Biennale in 2015.  To check Jordi's visual work please visit www.jordifornies.net

name: Aija Alsiņa
bio: Hailing from Latvia, Riga, Aija’s musical journey began at the tender age of 6 when she discovered her passion for the piano. Over the years, she immersed herself in various musical pursuits, from singing in choirs to playing bass in indie- and post-rock bands.  In 2013, a transformative moment led Aija to Barcelona, bidding farewell to her finance job and bandmates. Reconnecting with her childhood instrument, the piano, became a catalyst for her to channel her creative energy into original compositions. Aija’s next chapter unfolded in London in 2015, where she earned an MSc in Composition for Film and Media. Since 2019, she’s been back in Riga, infusing her compositions with a rich blend of experiences.  For Aija, music is more than notes; it’s a refuge from the mundane, a journey into the depths of emotion. Currently, her focus is on modern classical compositions for film, commercials, and standalone releases. 🎶✨  Limited Edition 12" Vinyl of both recent albums "Lightkeeper" (transparent magenta) and "Creation" (solid yellow), as well as sheet music available here: https://aijaalsina.bandcamp.com/merch

name: Saverio Lobeone
bio: Saverio Lobeone is a pianist and composer whose work centers on quiet reflection, subtle movement, and emotional clarity. Writing primarily for felt piano, his music embraces restraint, allowing space, silence, and delicate phrasing to shape each composition.  His pieces often unfold with a natural sense of continuity, guided by gentle repetition and understated harmonic shifts. Rather than seeking dramatic contrast, Saverio focuses on the nuance within stillness, where small details carry depth and meaning.  Rooted in introspection, his music reflects moments of transition, memory, and inner calm, expressed through a soft, intimate sound that invites the listener into a slower, more attentive way of experiencing time.

name: Thiago Hernan

I believe music is most powerful when it's honest, and I strive to let each performance reflect that honesty.   I'm excited to share my music with the world. Every piece I play is an invitation to slow down, listen closely, and feel something real. Whether the music is intimate and minimal or expressive and expansive, my goal is always the same: to create a space where listeners can connect - with the music, and with themselves.   This profile is a small window into my musical journey. I hope the music you find here resonates with you and becomes part of your own story.

name: Daniel Schrage
bio: It had been a while since I had a piano in the house. I wrote a ton of music in my teens and twenties, spent a fair amount of time in music licensing for film and television (with some highlights), but I put the music thing on hold for a while and ended up selling my last piano (also my first) for lack of use when I bought and moved back into my old family home, not anticipating that I’d start writing again. Sacrilege, I know, but for what it’s worth, I came to my senses.   During 2020's pandemic quarantine, I returned to the piano in earnest, intent on releasing some quiet and intimate solo piano works, which first occurred in late 2021 and has continued ever since. Each track is recorded from my family’s old Victorian. Needless to say, it holds a piano once again. It’s placed in the exact location of the upright I had growing up, and gets just as much use. name: soulful beats
bio: Meet Gary, the mastermind behind the chill vibes of "Soulful Beats," hailing from the laid-back city of Newcastle, UK. Kicking off this musical journey in 2022, Gary effortlessly channels the mellow spirit of lofi hip-hop, and guess what? He's already clocked over 4.5 million streams. Picture this: soulful melodies, easygoing beats, and a musical haven that's the perfect escape from the daily hustle. Gary's brainchild, Soulful Beats, is more than just a project—it's a chill-out session waiting to happen. In the cozy corners of Newcastle, he crafts tunes that capture the essence of laid-back living.  Drawing inspiration from the city's chilled vibes, Soulful Beats is a sonic oasis where nostalgia meets the contemporary. With over 4.5 million streams, Gary's tracks have become the go-to soundtrack for those seeking a tranquil escape. So, kick back, relax, and let the soothing sounds of Soulful Beats carry you away on a blissful journey. After all, in the world of Gary's music, there's always time for a chill moment.

name: Roger Swift
bio: I’m Roger Swift. One of the things I love to do is trail-running. When I am running, my mind becomes quiet and I can see things so much more clearly. It is giving me space to make the situation I’m in more enjoyable.   So I run. I get going and adventures cross my path. Any adventure that comes along is just fine for me: The state of no mind helps me to make the best of the situation: It makes me feel like I’m on top of the world. A feeling that I’d love to share with you.   But these are words, with a filter of the mind. I decided it is better to express myself in sounds; by sharing my experiences with you through piano songs. When playing music, I have an intuitive approach. Whatever I hear in my head whilst I’m running is the starting point for new tunes.   Hop along on my trail, I hope you’ll enjoy it as much as I do.

name: Kristoffer Eikrem
bio: Kristoffer Eikrem [ˈkrɪstɔfər ˈæikrəm] is a trumpet player, composer and producer based in Oslo, Norway. Blending acoustic and electronic textures, his music is known for its warm soundscapes, lush harmonies, and lyrical improvisations, drawing from jazz, hip hop, electronica, and R&B.  Eikrem studied jazz performance at the Norwegian Academy of Music, and shortly after graduating, was named Young Jazz Musician of the Year 2012 with the quintet Mopti. As a performer, he has toured extensively across Europe, India, and Japan, and appeared at many of Norway’s major festivals.  After years on the live jazz circuit, Eikrem shifted his focus toward production, diving into the world of lo-fi beats and instrumental hip hop, a transition sparked by early collaborations with Ivan Ave and Fredfades. Today, he creates soulful, genre-blurring productions and regularly collaborates with instrumentalists from around the globe.  www.kristoffereikrem.com

He is recognized for his jazzy and groovy style, subtly nuanced with serenity. He has had the opportunity to release his music on some of the best Lo-Fi labels such as Lo-Fi Girl, Lo-Fi Chill Records, Mutombo Records, and Aviary Bridge Records, among others.  His tracks have now accumulated over 50 million streams on Spotify.

name: Hoffy Beats
bio: Hoffy Beats, emerging as a music production titan since 2019, has unleashed over 300 original tracks, amassing over 200 million streams. His collaboration roster features artists such as Tonion and UKDD, alongside labels like Effortless Audio and LoFi Girl, cementing his status in the instrumental beat scene. As Jonas Hoffmann, he's ventured into composition, contributing over 25 pieces since 2022 with 20 million streams, and has delved into cultural projects, including the notable film "Kulturen er, hvor du er." His diverse projects span the instrumental Chill West with Dreamfield, to the satirical Danish Hip-Hop of Flot Hat, showcasing his adaptability. Hoffy's entrepreneurial flair is evident as one of the founders of Full Circle Records and his involvement in music management at Sauna . He's also a dedicated community member, serving on the Moorjazz Festival board since 2022. Beyond production, Hoffy shares his expertise through online music production courses and workshops, including engagements at Syddansk Musikkonservatorium. His live performances across Denmark, like collaborations with Ensemble MidtVest and festival appearances, have broadened his audience reach.

name: Zmeyev
bio: Konstantin Baratashvili known in lo-fi, jazzhop & chillhop scene as "Zmeyev" a producer with a 9-year experience. Starting with trival beats loading them in Soundcloud. In his tracks, he blends jazz-inspired vibes with laid-back drum beats. Mostly influinced on his style artists such as ntourage, Mujo, soho, Otesla, Loop Schrauber, ØDYSSEE, Screen Jazzmaster, .Eehou, T.Check and other old-school lofi producers, but biggest inspire was a J Dilla. In March of 2020 was released first successful song "Every Night" by "Chill Beats Music" label which debuted on the 1st place of "lofi beats" & "Jazz Vibes" playlists, gained around 28 million streams and became one of the most recognizable songs in chillhop. Re-released with "Chill Beats Music" first long-play album "Urban Melancholy" and gained ~ 30 million streams Next steps was collaboration with UNIVERSAL MUSIC with song "Chilled Room" which was included in movie "Confess, Fletch" (2022). Released two successful vinyl projects LP with Screen Jazzmaster "Digestif" on "Mutombo Records" & "from Side to Side" on "urbnundrgrnds". Nowadays he releasing his tracks on "urbnundrgrnds", "Mutombo Records", "Through Manhattan", "Lofi Jazz Records", "YouChill Music", collaborating with Screen Jazzmaster, T.Check, Mujo, ØDYSSEE, .Eehou, Phlocalyst & etc Co-founder of new chillhop, lofi label "Stay Peachy"

name: Age of Departures
bio: Age of Departures is a weekend project I (Daniel Ciurlizza) set up and produced with my composer/producer/sound designer friends who I mix, write, produce, and work with. When I'm not working on this, I'm: - Writing music for films, trailers, ads, and other visual media; - Cooking dinner too late and listening to an audiobook; - Thinking of different ways I can be better at helping the people I work and interact with. The name AGE OF DEPARTURES is inspired by all the stages of life as we grow. First, we are born. From there, we're old enough to go to school—the first time leaving the nest on a daily basis. What follows is life passing by at lightning speed: the need for independence from adults when we're teenagers, graduating from various levels of schooling and departing from friends, leaving home permanently, seeing friends and family pass away, and experiencing loss (and new life) at many levels. When finally, it's our turn to depart from this world—hopefully feeling fulfilled and having left it better than when we first arrived. Life is full of departures, but that's what makes it worth living as fully as possible.

name: Nyck Caution
bio: Nyck Caution is a Brooklyn born rapper and a longtime member of Pro Era, the New York hip-hop collective he joined in 2012 after a chance performance caught the attention of the late Capital STEEZ. Raised in the Mill Basin neighborhood and shaped early on by Eminem's influence, he attended Edward R. Murrow High School alongside future collaborators Joey Bada$$ and Capital STEEZ, forming the foundation of what became Pro Era. He released his debut mixtape, Disguise the Limit, in 2016, followed by the collaborative album Nyck @ Knight with fellow Pro Era member Kirk Knight later that year. Known for his sharp, rapid fire delivery, Nyck Caution continues to release solo work and remains an active voice within the Pro Era collective. His catalog has since amassed more than 294 million streams, with music that has soundtracked partnerships with Ferrari, Formula 1, and FaZe Clan, and he shows no signs of slowing down anytime soon.
