The album included three original compositions as well as readings of "My Favorite Things" and "A Love Supreme." Some critics took issue with her covers, foolishly questioning their worth in jazz terms. Like Universal Consciousness, World Galaxy is now regarded as a classic, full of brave, new musical thinking. 1972 also saw Coltrane transplant her family to Los Angeles from New York to be closer to her spiritual teachers and their organizations. The Impulse! release of Infinity caused Coltrane to endure extreme vitriol from jazz critics. Its original sessions were recorded at different times. Two tunes --"Living Space" and "Joy" -- were cut in 1965 with the classic quartet of John Coltrane, McCoy Tyner, Elvin Jones, and Garrison. Onto these performances she overdubbed strings and tambouras. The 1966 bookend cuts "Peace on Earth" and "Leo" were performed by the New Thing quintet with Alice on piano, organ, and vibraphone, Ali, Sanders, and percussionist Ray Appleton. In addition to strings, she replaced Garrison's bass parts with newly recorded ones by Charlie Haden, and added new solos of her own playing. Critics and fans howled their displeasure, but Coltrane's response was direct in an interview: "Were you there? Did you hear [John's] commentary and what he had to say?... We had a conversation about every detail; [John] was showing me how the piece could include other sounds, blends, tonalities, and resonances such as strings. He talked about cosmic sounds, higher dimensions, astral levels and other worlds, and realms of music and sound that I could feel." Coltrane issued her final album for Impulse!, Lord of Lords, in 1972; it capped her orchestral trilogy. Produced by Ed Michel, it showcased the artist playing harp, piano, organ, tympani, and vibes, backed by Haden and Riley above a 20-piece string section that she composed for, arranged, and conducted. In 1974, she was a co-billed featured guest on Joe Henderson's seminal album The Elements, and recorded the one-off Illuminations with Devadip Carlos Santana and saxophonist Jules Broussard. In 1975, Coltrane founded the Vedanta Center in Los Angeles and signed a recording contract with Warner Bros. The music she issued for the label revealed a deepening of her spiritual resolve and the sole desire to create music that reflected it. Eternity, issued in 1976, offered six tracks, ranging from the harp solo "Wisdom Eye" to "Om Supreme" for electric piano and six singers. Elsewhere, such as on "Spiritual Eternal," her trio with Riley and Haden were joined by reeds, winds, brass, and strings. She also delivered a radical re-envisioning of sections from Igor Stravinsky's Rite of Spring. Later that year, she released Radha-Krsna Nama Sankirtana. Forgoing jazz altogether, it offered Hindu devotional songs. Three tracks were chants, with Coltrane's organ and electric piano backing a vocal chorus, while the other two featured her interpretations accompanied by tambora or drums. For decades it was the most misunderstood record in her catalog. 1977's Transcendence followed suit. Coltrane alternately played harp, organ, and Rhodes piano as well as tambora. She was accompanied on half the album by a string quartet and the other half by a large vocal chorus. Her final date for Warner Bros. was 1978's double-live opus Transfiguration. Recorded in performance at UCLA's Schoenberg Hall in a trio with drummer Roy Haynes and Workman on bass, it offered Coltrane at full intensity playing piano and Wurlitzer organ. The track "Prema" included a nine-piece string section that was overdubbed later in the studio. With the album's release came Coltrane's retreat from public life. She did appear on Marian McPartland's syndicated Piano Jazz program in 1981. She also changed her name to Swami Turiyasangitananda and taught at the Vedantic Center -- and later the Shanti Anantam Ashram (later renamed Sai Anantam Ashram) on 50 acres near Malibu, California. She only recorded devotional Sanskrit hymns (or bhajans) for her congregation. Coltrane self-released a small batch of cassettes including 1982's Turiya Sings, 1987's Divine Songs, 1990's Infinite Chants, and 1995's Glorious Chants. In 1998, she appeared with her sons Ravi and Oran at a John Coltrane tribute concert at the Cathedral of St. John the Divine in New York City and again at Joe's Pub in 2002. She began recording again in 2000 and eventually issued the stellar Translinear Light on the Verve label in 2004. Produced by Ravi, it featured Coltrane on piano, organ, and synthesizer, in a host of playing situations with luminary collaborators that included not only her sons but also Charlie Haden, Jack DeJohnette, Jeff "Tain" Watts, and James Genus. After the release of Translinear Light, she played some selective dates in Paris in 2005, and a three-date tour in the fall of 2006 with Ravi in Ann Arbor, New York, and San Francisco. On January 12, 2007, Coltrane died of respiratory failure at Los Angeles' West Hills Hospital and Medical Center. Her catalog was selectively remastered and reissued in the United States and Japan. A decade later, Luaka Bop sought out the original masters of Coltrane's worship cassettes, assisted by her children. Enlisting original engineer Baker Bigsby, the label assembled a compilation from the four tapes. Entitled World Spirituality Classics 1: The Ecstatic Music of Alice Coltrane Turiyasangitananda, it was released in May 2017 to commemorate her 80th birthday and the tenth anniversary of her passing. The package included a lengthy liner essay by jazz historian Ashley Khan, Mark "Frosty" McNeil's master's thesis, and interviews with family, ashram members, and colleagues. It also included a remembrance by Surya Botofasina in conversation with Andy Beta. In 2018, Real Gone released Spiritual Eternal: The Complete Warner Bros. Studio Recordings. In July 2021, Coltrane returned to Impulse! with Kirtan: Turiya Sings. The set reframed her 1982 cassette with a mix that Ravi had only heard for the first time in 2020; he gave his blessing for its release. The original marked the only time Coltrane's singing voice had ever been heard solo on an album, accompanied by synths, organs, and synthesized strings. The 2021 mix offered only her voice accompanied by an organ. ~ Thom Jurek, Rovi

name: Tide Nebula
bio: Drifting between sound and stillness, Tide Nebula creates wellness ambient music designed to calm the mind and nourish the soul. With gentle textures, spacious tones, and a deep connection to nature, each piece offers a space for reflection, rest, and inner peace. Perfect for meditation, yoga, or quiet moments throughout the day.

name: Silent Motions
bio: Silent Motions is an ambient project dedicated to deep sleep and calm awareness. Created by a songwriter and producer with roots in film, TV, and game music, it explores minimalist instrumental soundscapes shaped by stillness, softness, and slow motion. The music is designed to gently support rest, allowing silence and tone to breathe as one.

name: Deneber
bio: Lush synth layers and slowly shifting tones. Deneber creates vast ambient soundscapes guided by celestial maps. A weightless drift through cosmic stillness.

name: OmniBrain
bio: OmniBrain is the innovative music project dedicated to creating music for sleep, relaxation, and meditation. Blending binaural rhythms and dynamic soundscapes, OmniBrain crafts auditory experiences that promote focus, relaxation, and mental clarity.

name: Allness
bio: ALLNESS is the ambient music project of composer Thomas Christopher Wilson. With more than 20 years of experience creating music under different names, Wilson has always been drawn to sound as a way to slow down, reflect, and find a sense of calm.  Using subtractive synthesis, ALLNESS explores soft frequencies, ethereal textures, and meditative soundscapes made for resting, focusing, contemplating, or simply taking a moment to breathe. As a core composer of the Lightwerx collective, Wilson’s work is rooted in wellness and the belief that music can help create a deeper sense of peace and wellbeing.

name: Hanna Lindgren
bio: Hanna Lindgren is a Stockholm-based composer and sound artist whose work begins with listening. Field recordings, mindfulness practice and close attention to sound itself feed into ambient pieces built around absorption - the question of how music can hold someone, emotionally and physically, rather than simply play in the background. Her catalogue has passed 164 million streams across different streaming platforms and 4.4 billion track views on YouTube.

name: Lightwerx Collective
bio: The Lightwerx Collective is a gathering of experienced music producers committed to crafting transformative and healing sounds. Specializing in genres such as Lofi, Ambient, Meditation, Solo Piano, and all things chill, the collective's releases demonstrate an unwavering commitment to promoting mental and emotional well-being through music and sound. With a mission to bring more healing sounds into the world, The Lightwerx Collective aims to elevate the overall sense of well-being through the power of music.  "Our goal is to provide individuals with a therapeutic auditory escape, allowing them to unwind, find solace, and embrace moments of tranquility in their lives," says founder Thomas Wilson. "Through our diverse range of musical offerings, we aim to contribute to the well-being of our listeners, fostering a sense of calm and promoting a positive mental space."  The Lightwerx Collective is dedicated to creating a harmonious space for wellness and relaxation. The various artists within the Lightwerx Collective produce an array of compositions tailored for various atmospheres, including spa environments, meditation sessions, yoga, sleep, lofi, ambient and moments of calm introspection.

name: MEITEI
bio: 冥丁は、“自明でありながらも幽微な存在として漂う日本”を「失日本」と名付け、日本を主題とした独自の音楽表現を展開する、広島・尾道出身、京都在住の文化事業家である。 電子音楽と日本古来の印象を融合させた、私的で概念的な音楽表現を特徴とする。『怪談』『小町』『古風（Part I, II, III）』からなる三部作シリーズを発表し、その独自性は国際的に高く評価されている。The WireやPitchforkなどの国際的音楽報道機関からも注目を集め、近年の音楽界における特異な存在として確立された。近年は、寺院や文化財、歴史的建造物といった空間へと表現の場を拡げ、日本的感性と現代的表現の新時代を見いだし続けている。2026年には世界遺産・音羽山 清水寺にて奉納演奏を実施し、同年4月、広島での10年間の活動の集大成ともいえるアルバム『瑪瑙』を発表した。 自身の人生や土地の記憶、時間の堆積を瑪瑙の層になぞらえながら、これまでの活動の軌跡を結実させた作品となっている。

name: Plasma Radio
bio: Plasma Radio is a burgeoning wellness artist with a background in scientific sleep studies.  Drawing inspiration from the free-flowing movement of Plasma, he meticulously produces ambient waves that promote healthy and productive rest.

name: Tokyo Psychedelic Orchestra
bio: Tokyo Psychedelic Orchestra is a new project by Shimon Hoshino — a shift from lo-fi surf to ambient and classical textures. Inspired by the Japanese concept of ma (間), each piece explores silence, dissonance, and layered harmony without rhythm. The album Chaos but Beautiful reflects modern Tokyo: chaotic yet vibrant, diverse yet connected. Shimon’s background in sound design brings a soft psychedelic edge to this rhythmless orchestra. Alongside this, he also shares music biweekly from four parallel projects: Shimon Hoshino , hario island, invisible design, and attic — each exploring a different emotional and sonic world. On YouTube, he shares daily 1-hour focus sessions — a space for stillness, creativity, and community.

name: WIDE HORIZON
bio: WIDE HORIZON creates immersive ambient soundscapes for deep sleep, meditation, and quiet reflection - blending atmospheric textures, gentle melodies, and cinematic calm. Inspired by stillness and open spaces, the music is designed to help listeners unwind, focus, and drift beyond the noise of everyday life.

name: Slumber Boy
bio: Slumber Boy is your emo lullaby artist, crafting ambient soundscapes to help you drift off into the night. With soft, melancholic tones and soothing melodies, Slumber Boy’s music is the perfect companion for quiet moments and deep rest. Close your eyes, let go, and let Slumber Boy guide you into a peaceful slumber.

name: Quiet Robot
bio: Quiet Robot crafts immersive post-ambient and downtempo electronic soundscapes, blending minimalistic hooks with soothing melodies. Each composition is thoughtfully designed to promote relaxation and deep focus, inviting listeners into a serene auditory experience.

name: D/S/T/N/C/E
bio: Inspired by the lineage of modern minimalist composers Jon Hassell, Brian Eno and Stars Of The Lid - D/S/T/N/C/E is the musically avant-garde / ambient offering from the global arts and music collective label WX//CLTV. Follow RE:LX for yoga sounds & re:inhabit for spa and massage music on Spotify Licensing inquiries: wxcltv.com / wxcltv@gmail.com

name: Decie Orion
bio: Soundscapes and ambient compositions for your inner calm. Delivered by Decie Orion.

name: Mosaic Tiles
bio: Mosaic Tiles is a musical project of Massimo Discepoli, an italian composer, drummer, producer, and sound designer active in the world of music for TV, film, and advertising. His work spans electronic, ambient, jazz, and experimental sounds, with a refined and versatile musical language that has led him to collaborate with many international brands and networks . As a composer, he has written music for TV series, documentaries, commercials, and short films. Alongside his work as a media composer, he also pursues personal projects, releasing albums both under his own name Massimo Discepoli and the alias Nheap, blending elements of ambient, electronic, post-rock, and jazz. www.massimodiscepoli.com

name: Mikael Arvo
bio: Minimalist ambient music from an introspective and contemplative mind.

name: Jamie McNeal
bio: Inspired by shifting skies, soft evening light, and the quiet atmosphere found between changing moments, Jamie McNeal creates ambient music with a calm and understated expression. The music supports relaxation, meditation, and deep rest.

name: Transformator
bio: I am driven by a dream of transforming this world into a better place, where hate and anger does not exist, but love, respect, equality and compassion is the most important things in each human beings life.

name: Spaced Out Dreams
bio: Guided by intuition and a love for minimalism, Spaced Out Dreams strips away the noise of modern life to find the calm hidden underneath.

name: Veloré
bio: Veloré has established career as a producer in Sweden, contributing to numerous TV and film projects while collaborating with a wide range of renowned artists.A classically trained musician, Veloré refined his skills at the Swedish Music Academy. Recently, he has shifted his focus to composing ambient music, creating serene and atmospheric pieces that encourage introspection and tranquility. Drawing inspiration from nature, quiet moments of reflection, and the subtle textures of sound, Velorés music evokes a deep sense of calm and connection.

name: Morgondimma
bio: A few years back I took a walk over a field, hidden in soft morning mist, which was the catalyst moment of inspiration behind the music here. A bit distant, from afar, through a slight filter of fog: allow yourself to get carried away by these pleasant sounds. Ambient for a peace of mind. Hand-crafted (with the help of synths) , close to the golden fields (barley probably, but other crops are fine too).

name: Moments Of Divinity
bio: Made for divine moments in life ❤️

name: Axial Flow
bio: My keywords: Atoms, distance, patience. Mixed together with analog warmth in an old studio.

name: Montbretia
bio: Montbretia is a music project inspired by Karlheinz Stockhausen’s visionary ideas, reimagining a world where the hum of food mixers, the churn of washing machines, and the grind of coffee makers blend into harmonious soundscapes.   In the early 2020s, Vesely (Montbretia) composed music for a range of projects, including audiobooks such as Skoromodlitby and Magorské Modlitby. His work has appeared on platforms like CalmApp and SoundMindApp. In 2023, his installation The Quint was exhibited in Nevada City, California, highlighting his connection to experimental music communities. Vesely also leads sound design workshops at events such as the Youtopia Digital Culture Festival in Trnava, Slovakia, and the Czech music festival Meziprostor.

name: La Perezosa
bio: I make relaxing instrumental music. Bagatelasmusic@gmail.com

name: Benjin Blund
bio: Benjin Blund is an artist who stands out for his melancholic vocals and atmospheric productions. Blund made his debut in music with his first song, “Beneath Your Beauty,” and released his breakthrough single,  “For a Moment,” which has garnered over  100 million streams on Spotify. Blending lo-fi, ambient, and electronic textures with themes of love, longing, and inner journeys, he offers listeners a deeply personal and intimate experience. Manager Contact fk2101309@gmail.com Hazep Music Entertainment

name: knownbyC
bio: "Life is like a box of chocolates. You never know what you're gonna get." — Forrest Gump. I hope you have a great day💙

name: Dreaming Atlas
bio: Dreaming Atlas is a London / Los Angeles based ambient music project focused on creating immersive soundscapes for relaxation, focus, and sleep. Blending analog warmth, modular synthesis, and organic piano, Dreaming Atlas crafts atmospheric compositions designed to bring a sense of calm and stillness to everyday life.

name: Celestial Keys
bio: Welcome to my world of tranquility and dreams. I'm Luna, the creator behind "Celestial Keys" Through my passion for the piano, I've woven a collection of peaceful and beautiful compositions, crafted to be the perfect soundtrack for moments of relaxation and dreaming.  Each note is a reflection of my desire to transport you to a serene space, where the stresses of the day melt away. The gentle melodies are an invitation to close your eyes, unwind, and let the music guide you into a state of peaceful contemplation.  My compositions, marked by delicate harmonies and thoughtful arrangements, are a personal journey into the heart of serenity. I invite you to join me in this musical exploration, where the piano becomes a vessel for emotions, creating an atmosphere that resonates with tranquility and beauty.  Feel free to incorporate my music into your creative projects – it's my gift to you. These compositions are offered copyright-free, allowing content creators to infuse their work with the same soothing magic that inspires me.  Thank you for being a part of this musical journey. Let the piano keys carry you into a world where dreams come alive through the beauty of sound. 🌙✨

name: Haze Drift
bio: Haze Drift is a studio project of slow piano and layered synthesis, built to blur the line between music and atmosphere. Each piece moves at its own pace, soft, textured, and easy to lose track of time inside. Made for long focus sessions, winding down, or stretches of the day when you just need something on.

name: Stellian
bio: Stellian is an Ambient and New Age artist who produces lush songs you can drift on.

name: Enyra
bio: Enyra makes ambient music for sleeping, resting and winding down. It moves slowly, stays quiet, and is written to sit underneath whatever else is going on rather than compete with it.

name: Ex Nocte
bio: ...For wandering minds... 🌙✨

name: Novah Scotia
bio: There is a distinct comfort in the hours when the world slows down. Guided by instinct rather than rigid structure, Novah Scotia captures these exact moments through weightless ambient music. Built from soft textures and patient repetition, each piece moves like rain against a late-night window—offering a space to breathe, rest, and let go.

name: Somniare
bio: I create music shaped by quiet forests, exploring the space between dreams — ambient sounds that drift like mist through the trees.

name: Delta Shores
bio: Enter a realm of ambient reverie where time stands still and relaxation gently unfurls its wings, carrying you into a world of peaceful solitude.

name: Zenful Whispers
bio: Zenful Whispers is a spiritual ambient project devoted to healing, nature, and a deep sense of calm. Created by a songwriter, producer, and multi-instrumentalist who began crafting instrumental ambient music in 2017, the project weaves gentle textures, organic soundscapes, and slow, breathing harmonies into meditative journeys. Rooted in stillness and intention, the music invites the listener into a serene inner space where nature, energy, and quiet reflection softly align.

name: Joy Parade
bio: Joy Parade makes ambient soundscapes designed for deep rest and quiet reflection. Moments captured rather than composed, shaped by feeling, patience, and the spaces in between.

name: Revivo Wide
bio: Without light, everything would be black. Music is my light, and every tone is a beam that reveals what longs to be seen.

name: Eomir
bio: Drift into space with the nordic resonance

name: Starfield Echo
bio: Starfield Echo drifts at the edge of sleep and starlight. Ambient textures and gentle tones for deep rest, lucid dreams, and cosmic stillness.

name: Noni Ammin
bio: Most of this is made late at night, when everything is quiet and there’s no pressure to make something “finished.” I keep what feels calm and honest, soft textures, slow shifts, and a steady sense of stillness. Music that stays with you, but never gets in the way.

name: Centauri
bio: There is something about the night. When night falls and the world sleeps, something else awakens — something that needs silence to be heard. I capture the sounds that want to be heard, yet are often lost in the noise of the world.

name: Binaural Resonances
bio: Binaural Resonances is a personal project dedicated to presence, balance, and inner alignment. Created by a songwriter and producer with over 15 years of experience in ambient music, the project focuses on crafting deep, immersive soundscapes for binaural listening and meditation. Through gentle textures, subtle frequencies, and slow-moving harmonies, the music is designed to support relaxation, focus, and inner stillness.

name: Wilfred Fredig
bio: Wilfred Fredig drinks light from shadows and forgets the name of time. Thoughts drift the wrong way, yet somehow arrive where they belong.

name: Nova Cantabile
bio: Trust your inner voice 💫

name: Noctilune
bio: Noctilune treats space as an instrument. The tracks are mostly ambience and long decay, with a faint analog haze that makes them sound as though they travelled some distance before arriving.

name: Elm Lake
bio: Elm Lake drifts. The ambient project of self-taught Swedish producer Niclas Gustavsson is built from synth melodies that ooze rather than arrive, laid over atmospheric textures in no particular hurry. It's music with nowhere to be, and that's exactly the point - it leaves room for whatever you bring to it. Elm Lake has passed 76 million streams across different streaming platforms and 2.5 billion track views on YouTube.

name: Sonura
bio: Sonura = Sonus (sound) + Aura (atmosphere, energy)  contact: prithvipanday07@gmail.com

name: Garden Collective
bio: Built from quiet echoes and weightless chords, Garden Collective crafts soundscapes that feel like standing on the edge of a quiet ocean at dusk. A place to pause and let the day fade away.

name: Mentitoso
bio: I make relaxing instrumental music. Bagatelasmusic@gmail.com

name: Amel Scott
bio: Shaped by stillness and a sense of perspective, Amel Scott’s atmospheric music draws inspiration from space and the feeling of looking outward into something endless. Immersive soundscapes unfold naturally for sleep, deep rest, meditation, and peaceful listening.

name: Arc Noir
bio: A note held until it disappears, then another.  Arc Noir works that way throughout: slow figures that repeat with small changes, quiet enough to meditate to and steady enough to keep a room calm. Nothing arrives suddenly.

name: Lunar Fern
bio: Lunar Fern is a soft-edged project rooted in minimal piano and natural ambient texture. The music moves at a nighttime pace, slow enough to breathe with, gentle enough to fall asleep to. There's no urgency here, just carefully arranged space. Made for late reading, light meditation, and the quiet end of a long day.

name: Luna Novina
bio: Stardust whispers, composing dreams.  🌠🎶

name: Suevite
bio: An ambient music project rooted in calm, restraint, and atmosphere. Suevite's music is shaped for introspective moments-those pauses where the world feels distant and quiet. Inspired by the Nordic winter, Suevite draws from frozen landscapes, pale light, and the deep silence that settles after snowfall. Subtle harmonies and slow-moving textures mirror everyday moments of quiet wonder, inviting the listener into a meditative space where simplicity, stillness, and emotion gently unfold.

name: Plainrest
bio: a soft pause in a loud world

name: Dance Of Centuries
bio: Dance Of Centuries makes music for slowing your thoughts and softening the edges of the day. Warm textures, delicate melodies, and long stretches of calm.

name: neon cosmo
bio: neon comso is an ambient music project from central Sweden, crafting relaxing and atmospheric sounds designed for peace, reflection, and quiet moments. Inspired by nature and the spaces between thoughts, the music offers a calm escape from everyday noise.

name: SleepTherapy
bio: The experts at crafting the best sounds to Rest, Relax, and Recharge.   Check out our Artist Playlists for a curated collection of all our sounds!

name: inertia.
bio: ambient producer from the UK  Insta : iaminertia_

name: Solitudes
bio: Solitude, gratitude, unity, wholeness, calmness

name: Endel
bio: Endel is a personalized app that combines music and neuroscience to create Endel Soundscapes to help you focus, relax, and sleep.   Be more productive, improve your sleep, and feel less stressed with science-backed soundscapes that adapt in real-time to you and your environment, using our Endel Pacific technology.  Get a taste of Endel with albums and playlists featuring exclusive collaborations with top artists like James Blake, The Blaze, Sia, and more.

name: IRYS BLÜM
bio: IRYS BLÜM is the ambient collaboration between soul sisters frogi and Lauren Malyon. Rooted in deep friendship and a shared love for nature, the cosmos, and all things ethereal, we create soothing soundscapes designed to calm, ground, and transport.  Blending frogi’s dreamy vocal production with Lauren’s emotive violin, ambient synths, and organic textures, each track is crafted entirely by the two of us. Visuals are just as essential to our process — every release is paired with artwork that reflects our inner world and connection.  Perfect for meditation, sleep, or simply slowing down, IRYS BLÜM is a love letter to stillness, beauty, and belonging.

name: cloudcrush
bio: Sounds for the mind. Every great story starts with a dream.

name: Rea Inarra
bio: Rea Inarra is a musician and artist based in France.  Her music is a gentle current, a flowing river of ambient textures, designed to soothe the mind and open the heart. Drawing inspiration from the natural world and the subtle energies of the body, her compositions create a sonic sanctuary for meditation, yoga, and deep relaxation.

name: oh, the joy.
bio: oh, the joy. is a well traveled wellness artist who seeks inspiration directly from nature in various parts of the world.  He’s known for creating beautiful unique soundscapes - a blend of calming nature sounds and gentle synth melodies that are designed to help people relax, sleep and focus.

name: øchd
bio: Guided by the quiet pulse of the city at night, øchd creates ambient soundscapes that blend calmness with exploration. Inspired by shifting frequencies and the hidden beauty of urban climates, the music drifts between stillness and discovery. With a passion for analog synths, each composition is shaped like a journey through glowing streets and endless horizons. slow down, listen deeper, and find serenity in the noise.

name: turquoise waters
bio: turquoise waters is an ambient music project by London, England based composer, producer and multi-instrumentalist Mikayl Dawood.

name: The Sound of Quiet
bio: Welcome to The Sound of Quiet.  A collaboration between Heather Bond & Adam Bokesch bringing you calm music for sleep and meditation along with ASMR and nature sounds for relaxation and stress relief. Take a deep breath. We’re glad you’re here.

name: Samuel Meadow
bio: Swedish composer and producer Samuel Engh is Samuel Meadow.    "Meditation and relaxation as a tool to create and make things happen has been the most important discovery on my journey. I created this project to help others relax more - Samuel Engh"

name: star climber
bio: one step at a time

name: Celestial Echoes
bio: Celestial Echoes is a deeply personal ambient project emerging from Sweden, shaped by a quiet desire to dissolve the boundary between listener and sound. The music is not written to stand apart, but to be inhabited —to merge with breath, thought, and inner stillness. Rooted in introspection and a Nordic sense of space, Celestial Echoes explores sound as a state of being rather than an object. Each piece is an attempt to become one with vibration itself, where music fades into presence and listening turns inward.

name: Jason Stephenson
bio: There is more to life than survival.  More than rushing. More than striving. More than carrying the weight of everything on your shoulders.  Jason Stephenson creates music for the part of us that longs for something deeper. The part that still seeks beauty, wonder, peace, connection, and meaning in a world that often pulls us in the opposite direction.  His music is an invitation.  To breathe. To feel. To remember what matters. To reconnect with yourself. To sleep. To dream again.  Whether you're listening in moments of stillness, reflection, healing, or before sleep, searching for a quieter place to land, you are welcome here.

name: Orion's Passage
bio: In the starry nights of Denmark, Orion's Passage, an ambient indie duo, crafts music that bridges the realms of dreams and reality. Inspired by the northern solar patterns, their ethereal melodies capture the essence of drifting between wakefulness and slumber. With a fusion of indian roots and northern origin they create a deep new universe where each composition invites listeners to explore the surreal landscapes of the mind, where dreams become journeys through the cosmos.

name: Xaverius Love
bio: Piano music 🎹, thanks for listening!

name: Pass Sacaglia
bio: Pass Sacaglia is a dreamer whose piano compositions are timeless, calm, and deeply emotional. His music carries a supernatural warmth, blending positive energy with heartfelt melodies that resonate with the soul. Each piece invites listeners into a serene world, offering a refuge of peace and a journey through life’s most cherished dreams. Pass Sacaglia’s sound is playful yet profound—a soundtrack for those seeking beauty, introspection, and a touch of the eternal.

name: Javi Lobe
bio: Javier Lobe is a Spanish pianist and composer. Born into a family of pianists, he studied piano and musicology at the Conservatory. Inspired in his youth by the piano music by composers such as Michael Nyman and Yann Tiersen, among others, he focuses his compositions on music for piano, and also for versions and arrangements for piano and strings.

name: C K Smith
bio: C K Smith presents calm neo-classical piano built around minimal melodies and spacious arrangements. The music focuses on soft emotional expression and quiet reflective listening, forming part of a wider collection of works by Arrowsmith exploring contemporary instrumental piano. https://www.arrowsmith.me

name: Drake Hughes
bio: Drake Hughes is the classical piano project of a musician and producer Jonatan based in Uppsala. With a background that includes music for video games and television, he brings a strong sense of atmosphere to every composition. Each track is created with close attention to tone, pacing, and space. Behind the project is a deep and enduring passion for music in all its forms.

name: Marlon Guild
bio: Welcome! My name is Marlon Guild and I make music.  Mostly for the piano. Close your eyes and enjoy.

name: The Masked Pianoman
bio: 'Rock and melt when you're on fire for music. Long live the piano!' (The Masked Pianoman)   I live only for music, I live only for my piano. There is no blood flowing in my veins, there are tones and melodies flowing. My calm compositions can be heard on all streaming platforms since 2020 and reach millions of listeners every month - enjoy these quiet, relaxing pieces and find your inner peace with my personal 'Felt Piano' sound.  I am very thankful for more than 100 mio. streams on all audio streaming platforms since 2020.

name: Morunas
bio: Hello, I'm Morunas, I live and breathe music! When I'm not sitting at the piano writing new pieces, I like going for a walk, playing board games, or enjoying good food. I'm also passionate about traveling to experience new cultures and gather inspiration for my compositions. After writing music for film and television for quite some time, I've decided to return to what I started with back then and what I love most: pure piano music! I hope it can help you find some peace in this hectic world. Thank you for stopping by. Project from Norman Dück

name: Loulaz
bio: Loulaz is a neoclassical piano project by London based composer and pianist Azzedine Loukil.

name: Josef Homola
bio: Josef Homola - Loves peace and that's why he started making calm, relaxing music for yoga, meditation, and stress relief! He also makes calm piano music with nature sounds. Check out @MartinCzerny for sad piano/cello music.

name: Jared Chance Taylor
bio: Composer, producer, & music director JARED CHANCE TAYLOR draws inspiration from a vast repository of music's definition to create raw, potent, and meaningful art. From ads to narrative, Jared composes for a wide variety of mediums. He recently completed music for an Adidas proof of concept film for a new sneaker to be released in 2023. He has written branded content for Microsoft, Verizon, Jaguar, Al Jazeera, Mitsubishi, Longchamp, and many more. He's composed documentary score for VICE and the popular online educational platform, Adventure Academy. His work has been showcased at Art Basel, in addition to a number of film festivals including DC Shorts, Oaxaca Film Fest, Festival Angaelica, LA New Wave International Film Festival, Mesa International Film Festival, Manifest Showcase, and Reel Stories Film Festival. Whether composing locally in Nashville or working closely with collaborators in cities from Los Angeles to London, Jared enjoys engaging with creatives around the world. Recent collaborators include Tim Myers, Eric Allaman, & Mikal Blue.

name: The David Roy Collective
bio: Born from an ancient faith and legacy, The David Roy Collective is a gathering place for composers and artists to create together. Founded by Anglican deacon Brock Hewitt in honour of his grandfather, organist David Roy Hewitt.   The collective blends cinematic, ambient, and instrumental music with worship songs — crafting soundscapes that tell truth-filled stories and reflect the beauty of God +  IG: @thedavidroycollective  Soli Deo gloria.

name: Brock Hewitt: Stories in Sound
bio: A peaceful pause in a hurried age — that hearts may rest, and hope arise +  Brock Hewitt is a composer, Anglican deacon and the founder of Stories in Sound Studios near Toronto. Gaining early experience as an intern at Hans Zimmer’s Remote Control Productions in Santa Monica, Brock learned important lessons that shaped his understanding of how music is crafted for film.  Brock's music moves between neoclassical, ambient, cinematic and minimalist languages—distilling musical ideas into clear structures where repetition, space, power and restraint become central elements of expression. Piano, chamber strings, voice, and hybrid orchestral elements are treated as the main materials in his musical colour palette.   Rather than separating sacred and secular practice, Brock’s work allows them to overlap with an "old world" feel. His role as an Anglican deacon informs an approach to composition that is shaped by liturgical thinking and a focus on the transcendent. This perspective gives his music a distinctive sense of prayerful stillness, serenity and eternal peace.  Brock continues to compose music for use in film, media, and artistic settings—developing a vast body of work that is unified by an ongoing interest in heavenly things.  ---  Contact for inquiries: storiesinsoundstudios@gmail.com  Follow the story on Instagram: @brockhewittstories  Read Brock's Letters: storiesinsoundquietoffice.substack.com  Soli Deo gloria.

name: Luke Howard
bio: Australian Music Prize-nominated composer Luke Howard has been described as “absolutely heavenly” (Mary Anne Hobbs, BBC Radio 6) and his music as “an ambient masterclass” (Musos’ Guide), but no words can fully capture the potency of Howard’s enthralling compositions. A pianist since childhood, Howard has scored films and performed with artists as diverse as Lior and Jeff Mills, capturing audiences with contemporary classical arrangements that curl and twist around the boundaries of a particular emotion. Though wordless, Howard’s songs perform a function unique to music as a medium – that of evoking without describing, bringing listeners to a feeling which defies articulating.  Now signed to UK label Mercury KX (Lambert, Olafur Arnalds, Solomon Grey), 2017 has Howard working across several projects: arranging the keyboard works of photographer William Eggleston, a pioneer of colour photography; a European tour culminating with a sold-out performance at the Hamburg Elbphilharmonie; and a new record.  Howard is one of Australia’s foremost practitioners of contemporary classical music. Having already accomplished so much and with more on the horizon, he is set to captivate audiences worldwide.

name: Auctor Noctis
bio: Music for the night

name: Monte Aria
bio: Earth is a planet filled with mystery. Somewhere out there, something may be dreaming of coming here — to discover a world unlike anything it has ever seen. I want to see the Earth through its eyes, through new eyes that reveal its greatness.

name: Casiotide
bio: Casiotide is an ambient artist and producer, sending calm to the listeners who need it.

name: Milo Ashen
bio: Milo Ashen creates atmospheric music shaped by silence, space, and the quiet moments between wakefulness and sleep. Combining delicate piano with warm ambient textures, his music is designed to slow the mind and create a peaceful space for rest, reflection, and deep sleep.  Each piece unfolds gently, inviting the listener to disconnect from the noise of the day and enter a more peaceful state of mind. Milo Ashen’s sound exists somewhere between ambient music, sleep music, and contemporary piano, with a focus on simplicity, depth, and atmosphere.

name: Solar Path
bio: I write sparse, reflective ambient music with piano and guitar at the center. Living in the forests of Sweden, I let the quiet and the natural rhythms of the woods guide every note, hoping to invite calm and stillness.

name: Meleira
bio: Maybe peace is not a place, but a moment. A warm cup in your hands, sunlight on the floor, rain outside the window. Small things that remind us to stop for a while.

name: Orchard of Dreams
bio: Slow ambient soundscapes for focusing, relaxing and sleeping 😴  Made in a basement somewhere in Stockholm

name: Through Quiet Tides
bio: Through Quiet Tides is an ambient music project that drifts through stillness and sound, weaving delicate textures into wide open space. Inspired by the hush of moonlit waters and the gentle pull of memory, each piece invites the listener into a world of calm and contemplation. It’s music for the in-between moments—where breath slows, time softens, and silence speaks.

name: Airhaven
bio: songs that float, not rush

name: Leo Lindholm
bio: Water and music might be the only things able to calm me.

name: Luka Vida
bio: Luka Vida makes ambient music inspired by still rooms, fading light, and the calm hidden inside silence.

name: Ortio
bio: Embrace the Hypnagogia. A Swedish writer who implements the nordic warmth to reach relaxation.

name: Alpenglown
bio: Hey, thanks for dropping by! I'm Alpenglown, an Ambient and New Age composer looking to provide the perfect soundtrack for a range of relaxation moods. I hope my compositions are as helpful to you as a listener as they are to me as a composer.

name: Sound Calligraphy
bio: Sound has a way of expressing what words cannot. With Sound Calligraphy, I explore the quieter side of music through flowing textures, subtle frequencies, and atmospheric layers. Each piece is a small journey, with no particular destination. Just space to listen, feel, and drift.

name: Nirav
bio: Nirav is an old word for silence. The music treats it as something solid, kept low to the earth and built around rather than filled in.

name: Thalia Serenade
bio: I invite you to discover my collection of compositions designed to help you relax, de-stress, enjoy a calm day and prepare for a restful night.

name: Zephyrical
bio: Peaceful and blissful tones to revitalize both the mind and body. Inspired by daily sunsets!

name: Zane Cassidy
bio: Every piece begins without a destination. Zane Cassidy allows simple sounds to become something much larger through patience and space. These are moments captured rather than strictly composed, resulting in a gentle, atmospheric experience that asks for nothing from you except a moment of stillness.

name: Jaumey
bio: Welcome to a reflection of myself, I hope my music helps you wind down and enjoy a nice moment

name: unvrsl frqncy
bio: Tune in and synchronize to the frequency of calmness, peacefulness and abundance

name: Mountain Explorer
bio: Drifting between stillness and sound, Mountain Explorer creates ambient journeys inspired by the quiet power of the mountains. Each piece is crafted to bring calmness, reflection, and a sense of wide open space, like standing at the edge of a summit with nothing but silence and sky. Designed for mindfulness, meditation, and deep rest, the music invites listeners to breathe, release, and reconnect with themselves.

name: Elevated States
bio: Elevated States refers to a heightened sense of awareness, serenity, connectivity to oneself and the divine universe. Transcending thoughts and accessing deeper levels of consciousness. Elevated States aims to guide you listeners on a journey towards these elevated states, through music, soundscapes, vibration and frequencies. Explore your inner worlds, unlock your potential, and find your own way to your elevated states. Elevated states is lead by music producer; Christopher Shorooi, a frequent meditator and mind-traveler. Make sure to check out more of my music: Chris Shorooi Lancine & Little Månvarv Aborre Prophétique

name: Elysian Fields
bio: Elysian Fields specializes in slow-moving ambient landscapes, carefully designed to help with focus, sleep or meditation. Made to slow the pace of things.

name: Velorae
bio: Velorae crafts soothing ambient worlds where time seems to stretch and tension melts away. Built on warm pads and spacious atmospheres, the music invites you to float, relax, and breathe more freely. Ideal for meditation, unwinding, and cosmic calm.

name: Djupiter
bio: Djupiter drifts on the outer edges of sound, weaving ambient drone soundscapes shaped by the silence of space and the glow of lunar light. Rooted in a fascination with the cosmos and the stillness it evokes, each track invites listeners into a calm, weightless atmosphere where time softens and tension dissolves. Created as music for rest, reflection, and release, Djupiter is a personal exploration of serenity - a soundtrack for meditating, winding down, or simply gazing at the stars.  Follow along on Instagram: @djupitersonics

name: Serelune
bio: Serelune is my meditative outlet. I was born in 1985 and began producing music in the early 2000s. This project is about slowing things down and creating space, using floating ambient tones and gentle movement to support focus, breathing, and inner calm. Follow for new releases <3

name: Arctic Halo
bio: Everything on Arctic Halo is tuned cold, wide chords held long enough to settle, with a little warmth always underneath. The writing favours weight over movement, arriving at its full width early and staying there. What changes is the pressure, not the direction.

name: Jon Stefans
bio: Jon Stefans makes ambient music rooted in improvisation, silence, and emotional drift. Each piece unfolds slowly, guided by instinct rather than structure — like a quiet thought disappearing into the night.

name: Adair Vernell
bio: I create ambient music around the piano, focusing on simple melodies, soft textures and a sense of space. I love the way a few simple notes can create a whole feeling, while leaving enough space for the listener to make the music their own. The music is there to accompany quiet moments, whether you’re resting, thinking or simply drifting away for a while.

name: Magnolia Dreams
bio: Under magnolia skies we dream in pale echoes, soft enough to disappear.

name: Luminous Lotus
bio: Sleep ambient from the Swedish west coast.  Through soft atmospheres and gentle melodies, I hope to share the peace I find in ambient music with you.  Much love

name: Oblivionis
bio: I make ambient and meditative music meant to slow things down. Sounds that move gently, leave space to breathe, and help the body settle.   I'm a drummer in my everyday musical life, but this is a different place for me creatively. A quieter space where I work with long tones, soft textures, and simple movement — music that isn't in a hurry.   The focus is on calm, repetition, and atmosphere. Music to sink into, to rest with, or to have playing while doing nothing at all.   This music exists to help you come down in tempo, clear a bit of space, and breathe a little deeper.

name: Quiescente
bio: Sleepy Ambient by Domy Castellano

name: XYROS
bio: Blending soothing textures, gentle melodies, and atmospheric tones, XYROS crafts music that invites listeners into moments of peace, stillness, and restoration.

name: Chillnaut
bio: I find inspiration in the stillness of nature and the sounds that often go unnoticed. Through ambient music, I explore gentle atmospheres, evolving textures, and the beauty of simplicity. A place to slow down and let the mind wander.

name: Boreal Light
bio: Boreal Light draws its palette from the far north, the cold clarity of winter air, the slow burn of a horizon at dawn. Piano and synthesizer move together in long, unhurried arcs, building music that feels expansive without demanding attention. Restful and quietly ambitious: made for open spaces, and for minds that need room to wander.

name: Rowan Guthrie
bio: Rowan Guthrie was born on July 28th, 1987, to electrical engineer Mathias Guthrie and real estate agent Amelia Guthrie-Wood. Growing up in a small town located in the province of  Newfoundland, Canada, Rowan got obsessed with the immaculate wonders of nature. His father took him hunting once, at the age of 8, which resulted in Rowan realizing immediately he did not want to kill any living creature, unless absolutely necessary and done with respect for the creature. He’d rather give up his own life. With a completely different perception of life and how one should live, Rowan found it hard to connect and identify himself with his family. Moreover, he found his peers somewhat intimidating and never really had any human friends, leaving him feeling like an outsider. Instead, Animals and Plants were his company of choice. Nature offered him a safe place. To feel seen and accepted as he was. To feel at home.   ‘It doesn't matter whether it’s the creepy crawlers, like for example the Ant kingdom. Have you ever witnessed such smooth teamwork anywhere else? Or the plants: how they are connected through mycelium hidden in the earth. Or the birds, that are connecting the air with the trees and the ground, eating insects, digesting them, and from their faces new life grows. It is all connected. We are all connected. But we do not have to intervene to learn: just observing is enough. Invest your presence with nature and your riches will be without limits.’

name: Closed Lids
bio: Closed Lids, the piano project of Canadian composer Matthew Reid, delivers introspective and soothing music for moments of quiet relaxation. Drawing from influences like neoclassical film scores and avant-garde techniques, each piece is thoughtfully crafted to create a calming and unique atmosphere, perfect for background enjoyment or peaceful reflection.

name: Felix Manzi
bio: Composer and Musician, Felix Manzi, has over 20 years of experience in music. With a bachelor’s degree in music performance, and international touring experience under his belt, Felix now focuses on composing and producing high quality music, mainly for visual media. Some of his placements include Disney, Google, Netflix, Taco Bell, and various TV shows and broadcasted Sports events.

name: Rick Gallagher Project
bio: Rick Gallagher Project is the cross-genre music platform of Pittsburgh based composer/pianist/producer Rick Gallagher. A career jazz pianist/educator, Gallagher brings his creative harmonic approach, melodic vision, improvisational spirit and delicate soulful touch to a blend of musical genres. Gallagher's musical markings relax, stimulate, and inspire. His compositions have been synced to all forms of media ranging from major TV networks to film projects and many other commercial applications across the US and the globe. Upright Sketches is a series of solo felt piano recordings, with songs composed using blended styles ranging from neo-classical to modern contemporary film music. In these recordings, Rick continues to explore the organic, warm, felt piano sound with his blended influences and delicate soulful touch. This personal collection was recorded at his home studio in Pittsburgh, PA. There are currently 12 albums in the "Upright Sketches" series. Please follow for the latest release updates and other info. Also follow Rick's jazz recordings under artist name Rick Gallagher . New jazz trio album out now! Felt Sessions #1 blends the nostalgic sound of a traditional jazz trio with the soft, felt tones of a modern upright piano. Paul Thompson on bass, and David Jamison on drums. More info at www.rickgallagher.com

name: Helmut Schenker
bio: Helmut Schenker is where Swedish composer Rickard Nilsson writes for the screen in his head. Piano, orchestra and electronics fold into each other, and each piece plays like a scene from a film yet to be made — fragile one moment, epic the next, underwater mystery giving way to something heroic. Nilsson has spent years as a touring keyboardist behind some of Scandinavia’s best-known artists; this is the more personal end of that work. His music has passed 50 million streams across different streaming platforms and has been used in videos reaching 10.2 billion views on YouTube. He also records as Speedy The Spider and with Felicia Öjemark Wiik as Wendy Marcini.

name: Nils Frahm
bio: When it comes to defining the space between classical and electronic music, hardly any other name is mentioned as often as that of the Berlin-based pianist, composer and producer Nils Frahm. His unconventional approach to an age-old instrument, played contemplatively and intimately, and on a mesmerizing scale through his vast stage shows, has won him many fans around the world.   Nils’ breakthrough album Felt was released on Erased Tapes in 2011. Two years later, he returned to critical acclaim with his album Spaces, expressing his love for experimentation and answering his fan’s call for a record that truly reflects what they experience during his live shows.   Following the release of his album All Melody in 2018, Nils set off for another two-year-long tour, with over 180 sold out performances. In 2020, he released the concert film Tripping with Nils Frahm, trying to freeze a moment of this journey and capture his concerts in picture and sound. In celebration of Piano Day, Nils shared Graz in March 2021, followed by the dub-influenced seven-track album 2X1=4, and Old Friends New Friends, a collection of previously unreleased solo piano tracks. In September 2022, he put out his critically acclaimed, expansive album Music For Animals, an ambitious and compelling set different to anything Nils has released to date. Since then, he is back touring all over the world, presenting his original blend moving between the worlds of experimental, ambient and electronica.

name: Francesco Le Metre
bio: Francesco Le Metre is a Sicilian-born composer and pianist whose music moves between piano intimacy and electronic textures.  His debut album "Abroad" (2020) explored distance and belonging, while singles like "Falling For" and "Sunset" trace his evolution from solo piano into electronic atmospheres. His piece "Nocturne" has surpassed fifteen million streams worldwide.  He also composes for film and television, most recently on "Being Heumann" (2026), the new film from Siân Heder, the Academy Award-winning writer-director of "CODA." His other screen credits include the GLAAD Media Award-winning Netflix documentary "Disclosure" (2020), "Unknown: Cave of Bones" (2023), and Misan Harriman's Oscar-nominated short "The After" (2023).  For listeners, his music offers an intimate journey through sound, nostalgic yet hopeful, shaped by memory, family, and the warmth of his Sicilian roots.

name: Sayuri Hayashi Egnell
bio: Sayuri Hayashi Egnell is a composer, sound artist who is born in Japan, based in Stockholm, Sweden.  She enjoys ambient sounds probably because of her being born and raised in an environment with beautiful nature and surroundings. In 2013 her music for Urban Soundscape Competition was given the Gold Award by Ryuichi Sakamoto and was played for 3 months during Sapporo International Art Festival in Japan. She also created music for the Nobel Peace Prize 2014 displayed at the Nobel Museum. Writing music for films have become somewhat central for them and they have won awards on some International Film Festivals. She has her original works, but also produced many collaborative works with musicians, dancers, poets, painters and films.

name: Tim Linghaus
bio: memory sketches

name: YARA
bio: YARA’s music is all about showing the beauty, safety and calm in nature and her serene piano pieces aim to embody this. She writes beautiful melodies that are tastefully accompanied by intricate harmony and handles her music with true passion and care. Having great success with her song My Hands (reaching nearly 4 million streams on Spotify), she intends to build on this winning formula and keep delivering tender pieces of art.   YARA is a Swedish/Dutch multi-disciplinary art project where composer and pianist YARA teamed up with Dutch dancer and videographer Vera and Jesse. With 10 million streams across her full catalog, YARA is becoming a big name in the (neo)classical scene.

name: Michiel Borstlap
bio: Michiel Borstlap is a world renowned pianist and composer who played concerts in more than 90 countries. He won industry awards like the Dutch Gouden Kalf, an Edison, the Thelonious Monk Award in the USA and the Prize for Best Soloist in Brussels. Michiel collaborated with artists such as Herbie Hancock, Wayne Shorter, Gino Vannelli, Iggy Pop, Bill Bruford, George Duke, Billy Cobham, Jimmy Haslip, Peter Erskine, Benjamin Herman, Pat Metheny, Jeff Tain Watts, Gene Jackson, DJ Joris Voorn etc.  Michiel has played with classical musicians such as Janine Jansen, Lavinia Meijer and Ludovico Einaudi, and has been a soloist with the Radio Philharmonic Orchestra, Kiev Soloists, the Metropole Orchestra and has collaborated with conductors such as Vince Mendoza, Jan Stulen, Jurjen Hempel, Arthur Arnold and Lawrence Renes.  Michiel Borstlap plays piano solo concerts around the world. He composed many works including 10 solo piano albums. The sheet music is bundled in the piano book 'The Piano Collection'.  Michiel is Founding Partner of B2B Music Network Gallery Play Media and more recently of  Intono AI - Human Presence Infrastructure   Michiel is ambassador for IWC Watches and Steinway & Sons. Michiel is a member of Akademie van Kunsten (KNAW).  For more info, head to the links below: https://www.facebook.com/michielborstlap https://www.instagram.com/michielborstlap https://www.linkedin.com/michielborstlap

name: Piotr Wiese
bio: Piotr Wiese is a Polish-born, Spanish-based composer, pianist, and producer with over 150M streams worldwide. His music pairs intimate piano writing with cinematic electronics.  In 2025, Wiese’s track “Idio” featured in Paolo Genovese’s Follemente – the highest-grossing Italian film of the 2024–25 season ($22M+ worldwide), sold to more than 140 territories. In 2026, Piotr signed an exclusive worldwide publishing agreement with Bucks Music Group (David Bowie, The Rolling Stones, Ed Sheeran). His music has been featured on renowned radio shows (BBC, KEXP, SBSR.FM), at prestigious festivals (European Film Festival, the 75th Sanremo Music Festival), and covered by notable music magazines (Music Week, Headphone Commute, Gezeitenstrom).  Wiese holds an MA in Composition from the University of Bristol. His releases span Moderna Records, 1631 Recordings, Bigo & Twigetti and LoFi Girl, a global leader in lo-fi music, with distribution including Decca/Universal Music. Alongside studio work, he brings his cinematic catalogue to the stage, evolving from solo piano to a fuller show with electronics.  In the heart of Spain’s Valencia region, in a tiny village surrounded by mountains near the Mediterranean Sea, Piotr has realised his dream of turning part of his old house into Llocnou Studio. From this newly completed space, he is creating KOSMOS, a genre-defying album of piano and electronics centred on a restored 1895 C. Bechstein grand: a piano as a lens on infinity.

name: Jacob David
bio: My grandfather didn't like me playing his grand piano. He said that thanks to me, his ears were falling off. In church, people remarked I played too quickly, too rhythmically or just with too much 'jazz'. Perhaps it is thanks to them that I learned to play much softer and began writing such quiet music. As I sit at the piano, my fingers producing barely a whisper, I still imagine them behind me, chiming in.   Thanks for joining me in this quiet place, and for tuning in. Feel free to stay a while - hope I won’t make your ears fall off.   -  New album Kindred with Elliott Jack Sansom, out 6 November. Sheet music and more on jacobdavidmusic.com

name: Treman
bio: Treman is piano music by composer Josh Jacobson. Growing up in a musical family in Ithaca NY, Josh was surrounded by classical music from a young age. His mom was the concertmaster of an orchestra and taught violin lessons in the living room, so he absorbed a lot of music even before beginning piano lessons at age five. Josh is now based in Los Angeles and primarily creates electronic music under his name. He's toured around the world performing his own music and with other bands. Some highlights include playing Coachella, Seoul Jazz Festival and European festivals and appearing on TV shows ranging all the way from The Tonight Show and Jimmy Kimmel to Good Morning America and Ellen. Josh has composed original music for Mazda, Roland, and a documentary featured in the Manhattan Film Festival. Getting away from all of the commotion of the music business and just recording soulful piano music like this is a spiritual pursuit and a return to Josh's roots. So Treman is a project about musical origins, which is why it's named after the state park in Ithaca with a stunning gorge trail. As a composer, Josh brings an intuitive sensibility, with a sound that references the classical piano tradition while also bringing in the free flow of jazz improvisation and the thoughtful minimalism of modern pop music. The music here aims to capture the most direct expression of how magical it feels to sit down at the piano and just play. Listen, relax, and enjoy :) -Josh

name: Ros Gilman
bio: Ros is a classically trained, award-winning, British-German composer, music producer, conductor and violinist, born in Russia. His work includes international productions such as HBO, ARTE and France 5, as well as a number of acclaimed independent films, which screened at major international festivals like Berlin International Film Festival (Berlinale) and Locarno International Film Festival. Ros' portfolio ranges from large orchestral scores to intimate solo strings with electronics and solo piano.  Trained as a film composer, concert violinist and conductor at the University of Music, Vienna and the Royal College of Music, London, Ros holds a Master’s Degree in Composition for Film, a Bachelor’s Degree in Classical Composition, a Diploma in Concert Violin and a Diploma in Music Business from the Music Business School, London.  Ros' work has earned him various awards (Fimucité, Indie Film Awards, GSFF), enjoyed great support on streaming platforms ( 20M+ streams) and repeated editorial support from Spotify, Apple Music and Pandora. Further support came from major radio stations (BBC, NDR) and national press (BBC Music Magazine, The JC).  As a concert violinist, Ros performed on three continents as well as on national TV and national radio (ABC, Kanal 1, Ö1) and as a conductor has collaborated with the Macedonian Symphonic Orchestra, Prague Metropolitan Orchestra and others.

name: Megan Wofford
bio: LA-based pianist and composer Megan Wofford crafts tender melodies and dreamlike atmospheres, building musical stories one keystroke at a time. Blending contemporary piano with jazz influences, her expressive playing and rich harmonic textures create an intimate, reflective listening experience. Throughout her career, Megan has toured and collaborated with a wide range of artists, with performances featured in campaigns for Samsung and on television for CBS and Nickelodeon. Her music has reached listeners worldwide, amassing hundreds of millions of streams across platforms and billions of track views on YouTube.

name: Mikael Sapin
bio: Mikael Sapin is a Spanish composer and pianist known for his minimalist and neoclassical piano music. He was born on July 7, 1978 in Seville, Spain. His piano works evoke profound emotions and craft serene, introspective sonic landscapes.

name: Julian Rivers
bio: Julian Rivers creates comforting music for the days when you need everything to move a little slower. Patient melodies and warm textures blend seamlessly to cushion the noise of the outside world.

name: Ryan Judd
bio: Ryan Judd is a Billboard-charting recording artist, award-winning musician, board-certified music therapist, and fingerstyle guitarist known for his warm, calming sound on nylon-string guitar.  His music is created for people on a healing journey, offering peaceful soundscapes for relaxation, stress relief, meditation, sleep, massage, and quiet reflection. With gentle melodies, spacious arrangements, and a music therapist’s sensitivity, Ryan’s recordings help listeners slow down, ease tension, and reconnect with a deeper sense of calm.  Ryan’s music has been streamed more than 570 million times and is featured on editorial spa, meditation, and relaxation playlists and stations. His recent album, Into the Calm, offers a soothing collection of peaceful guitar music for rest, reflection, and emotional renewal.  As a board-certified music therapist, Ryan has worked with children facing life-threatening illnesses, an experience that continues to shape both his music and mission. He donates a percentage of his profits to Love Bus, a nonprofit organization that provides free music therapy services to pediatric cancer patients.  “Ryan Judd’s emotional awareness from his music therapy background informs every note he plays. He has become a singular voice in the world of instrumental guitar, creating exceptional music that is thoughtful, deeply felt, and exquisitely played.”  Tom Eaton, two-time Grammy-nominated multi-instrumentalist, composer, producer, and mastering engineer

At the same time, all parts are played on the same guitar. The guitar was handmade by Masaki Sakurai in 1982 at the M. Kohno workshop in Tokyo, Japan.   If you like this music, you may want to check out the work of Alan Shoesmith who is the original music alter-ego of Alain LaFontaine.   Thanks for listening !

name: Carl Borg
bio: Carl Åborg who goes by the artist name Carl Borg is a Swedish producer, sound designer and film music composer. Carl started making electronic music at the age of 14. He found his way into house music after buying a Yamaha A3000 sampler, sampling through his friends and parents vinyl collections. In 2004 he began to tour through Europe, South Africa and the Baltics together with Forss (Eric Wahlforss) as Forss Versus Borg. Playing live-sets consisting of both up-tempo house tracks and experimental glitchy electronica. Carls debut release, the classic 12 inch Splinter Body Scene EP, was released on German label Sonar Kollektiv during that same time. Since then he has released several EPs, remixes and produced a number of original soundtracks throughout the years, garnering over 50 million streams worldwide.   One of the soundtracks, Tasteology Soundtrack made for House of Radon in Stockholm, has today over 20 million streams on Spotify. With several tracks on the platforms largely popular playlists like Peace and Sleep.   Carl played an important part of the band project SFB, The Stoner + Forss + Carl Borg, a fusion of acoustic jazz and live electronica. The project resulted in a number of live gigs around Sweden, and later the album The Lektor Tapes on Gothenburg based label Hoob Records.

name: picture frames
bio: Picture Frames is an experimental, ongoing art project by Mumbai-born, Los Angeles-based artist Shaan Chhadva. Begun at age 21, the project serves as the musical equivalent of a time capsule, documenting Chhadva’s adult musical life with a yearly album. Each album is created with two key rules: everything must be started and finished in a single day, and every track must be recorded in a single, honest take. The project embraces raw imperfection, capturing moments of creativity without polish, re-dos, or editing. Each track is titled with the exact time it was recorded, turning the music into personal timestamps of Chhadva’s life. This project is a celebration of imperfection, freedom, and growth, offering listeners snapshots of a life lived through sound.

name: Erland Cooper
bio: Erland Cooper is a Scottish composer, producer & multi-instrumentalist originally from Orkney. As a solo artist, he has released five acclaimed studio albums, with multiple companion LPs & EPs, including a trilogy of work inspired by his childhood home, as well as themes of nature, people, place & time. His work combines field recordings with traditional orchestration & contemporary electronic elements. Through music, words and cinematography he explores landscape, memory & identity. He develops these themes further by partnering with artists, writers and poets. Cooper also works across mixed media projects including installation art & film. He’s widely known for burying the only existing copy of the master tape of his first classical album in Scotland, deleting all digital files & leaving only a treasure hunt of clues for fans and his record label alike to search for it. The tape was found, unearthed and released in 2024 reaching number 1 in the official classical album charts.  “Nature’ s songwriter” Guardian  “..speaks to a universal emotional truth”  MOJO  “at once calming and euphoric, with a beauty that’s its own justification”  UNCUT  “..exploring the place where electronic and classical music can co-habit”  The Quietus    “Wonderfully nuanced songwriting matched to lung-bursting string arrangements.” CLASH   “like a spiritually charged requiem for the pristine landscapes that inspired it”  Electronic Sound

name: Freya Goldmark
bio: Freya Goldmark (b. 1996) is a British violinist known for her dynamic career as a soloist, chamber musician, and artistic director. In 2025 Freya was chosen as a Classic FM 30 under 30 Rising Star. She regularly performs at prestigious venues and festivals worldwide including the Barbican Centre, Royal Albert Hall, and Cadogan Hall, and made her solo debut with the BBC Philharmonic in 2024 and BBC Scottish Symphony Orchestra in 2025. A sought-after collaborator, she is first violinist of the Ligeti Quartet and frequently records for film, television, and artists across genres. Freya’s debut solo album, set for release in late 2025, showcases her distinctive artistic vision, blending classical and contemporary influences. She is the founder and artistic director of Stamford International Music Festival.

Rooted in piano and slow harmonic movement, the project favors shadow over clarity, finding something honest in the in-between. Music for introspection, for fog, for the kind of silence that has a color.

name: Mshvidi
bio: Mshvidi was created around one simple idea: stillness is not emptiness, it is a place where you can finally hear yourself. The project grew from a need to step away from constant movement and create music that feels like a pause in everyday life. Mshvidi explores quiet moments through soft ambient textures, gentle melodies, and slowly evolving soundscapes, leaving space for thoughts to settle naturally. The name itself reflects the spirit of the project, peacefulness, calm, and the feeling of having nowhere to rush. Mshvidi’s music is made for those small moments when the world becomes quieter and you can simply breathe, reflect, and be present.

With a blend of ambient textures and melodic undertones, they create a space where stress melts away and the mind can wander freely. Rubicon Fray is your soundtrack for relaxation and reflection.

The music begins without a map, unfolding by following whatever direction the sound itself suggests. Each piece is allowed to move freely, shaped by listening instead of control. With a deep connection to meditation and yoga, South To Somewhere creates gentle, flowing environments that support stillness, breath, and inward focus— music that travels not toward a place, but into presence.

name: Izzi Dunn
bio: Known for her valued contributions to various recordings, Izzi Dunn (real name, Isabelle Dunn) is an English cellist and singer. Dunn became involved with music at an early age. Raised by her mother (a classically trained opera singer) and her father (a singer and radio presenter), music, sound, and performance were already a prominent aspect of her life by the time she decided to take up cello lessons at the age of nine. Born in Sheffield, she grew up in Hastings, East Sussex on a diet of traditional jazz and classical music, with her parents frequently playing classics from the likes of Frank Sinatra and Stan Kenton. She went on to study her instrument with a scholarship program at the Trinity College of Music, where she discovered U.K. soul and hip-hop. Throughout the years, she developed her cello skills, honing her craft through numerous performances and live sessions, eventually paving the way for collaborations with numerous talented British musicians. Having worked with a number of talents from Roots Manuva and Duran Duran to MJ Cole and Wookie, she put out her first release and eponymous EP in 2002. The effort received widespread acclaim and was praised for its varied and eclectic sound palette. She followed up with her first album, The Big Picture, in 2003, via her own label, Fireworx. Like its predecessor, it was commended for its innovative songwriting and Dunn's open-minded approach to sound, tone, and mood. In 2005, she formed the all-female string collective Demon Strings. The group came to prominence for its collaborative efforts and provided backup for recordings and live performances with artists such as Madness and Damon Albarn's many projects: Gorillaz, Blur, and the Good, the Bad, and the Queen. Dunn also continued to put out her own solo efforts. The Cries & Smiles album (2010) and Visions EP (2012) both displayed even further diverse and assorted sounds. Centered on Dunn's cello and vocal skills, her songs had begun to incorporate different kinds of breakbeat, neo-soul, trip-hop, and electronic folk, all the while continuing to receive commendation for her honest and observant lyrics. Her third full-length, Recycle Love, was released in 2017. Featuring performances from Demon Strings and Leeds-based ensemble the Haggis Horns, the record encapsulated the fears, paranoia, and anxieties caused by social division and also included more introspective lyrics focusing on the self. Recycle Love was produced by Dennis "Dego" McFarlane of the electronic outfit 4hero. ~ Rob Wacey, Rovi

name: Niclas Lundqvist
bio: Niclas is a Stockholm-based organic ambient composer and producer with a lifelong passion for creating immersive sound worlds. Trained in classical piano from the age of seven, he blends that foundation with modern production to craft music that feels cinematic, emotional, and expansive.  By day, Niclas scores music for film, television, advertising, and games — shaping sound to fit visual stories. Under his own name, he focuses on organic ambient and cinematic works, merging classical storytelling with contemporary electronic textures to create music that invites deep listening and reflection.  Since 2021, he has also released under several aliases, exploring different aspects of sound and mood: LUNIQ., Velvet Slumber, and Sonic Passage. Across projects, his catalogue has surpassed 120 million streams, reaching listeners worldwide.  Niclas’s music appears on labels including Signal Alchemy, Echoes Blue, Silent Sonic, Valley View, and Buddha Lounge, each release reflecting his ongoing search for atmosphere, emotion, and beauty within stillness.

name: Rand Aldo

Behind the name is Johan Eriksson, a Swedish composer based in Falun who has spent over a decade writing for theatre, concert and film, and who completed a PhD at the Royal Birmingham Conservatoire in 2020. The delicate productions of Rand Aldo wrap you up in a comforting soundscape of ambient lullabies where time and space cease to exist. The music has found an audience in enormous numbers - more than 312 million streams across different streaming platforms and over 9 billion track views on YouTube.

name: Bayesian
bio: Bayesian approaches ambient music through observation and accumulation. Instead of grand gestures, the sound is shaped by small, repeating details-tones that evolve gradually, like patterns noticed over time in nature. The music carries an organic, grounded quality, reminiscent of listening closely to wind, water, or embers shifting as they burn. Bayesian invites a calm, attentive kind of listening, where subtle changes matter and meaning forms slowly, through presence rather than intention.

name: Embertone
bio: Grounded and tactile, Embertone draws from the quiet presence of the natural world. The music is inspired by simple, elemental sounds -the soft crackle of a fire, water moving through a mountain creek, the steady calm of being outdoors with nothing to interrupt the moment. Built from warm textures and slow movement, Embertone feels close and physical, inviting the listener to settle in rather than drift away. It's ambient music rooted in earth and sensation, offering a sense of warmth, stillness, and natural flow.

name: Lake Melville
bio: Lake Melville is a Swedish ambient music project devoted to calm, inner balance, and energetic alignment. Created by a songwriter and producer with over 15 years of experience, the project explores meditative soundscapes inspired by the chakra system and solfeggio frequencies. Through slow-moving harmonies, warm drones, and gentle textures, the music is designed to support relaxation, emotional clarity, and a deeper connection to inner stillness and well-being. name: Ursae Minoris
bio: Named after a constellation that has guided travelers for centuries, Ursae Minoris explores ambient music through a cosmic lens. The project draws inspiration from phenomena far beyond human scale-supernovas collapsing into silence, particles vibrating in quantum uncertainty, vast distances measured in light rather than time. Sound is treated as matter in motion: expanding, decaying, re-forming. The music drifts between the monumental and the microscopic, inviting the listener to sense both immensity and fragility at once, as if tuning in to the quiet hum of the universe itself.

bio: Sage Brixton creates modern classical piano music from Uppsala, Sweden. He works as a musician and producer, with extensive experience composing for video games and television. That visual background can be heard in pieces that often suggest scenes, memories, or passing moments. His music is melodic but unhurried, balancing warmth with a sense of openness. He prefers honest arrangements where the piano remains at the centre. Under the name Sage Brixton, he shares intimate compositions made for calm and attentive listening.

name: Axel Bennett
bio: Axel Bennett is a pianist, musician, and producer from Uppsala. His music is shaped by a long-standing fascination with the expressive possibilities of the piano. Alongside his own work, he has composed and produced music for video games and television. Music has remained a constant passion throughout his life and career. Through Axel Bennett, he explores the quieter side of contemporary classical piano.

name: Ludovic Agnes

name: Gustav Potter
bio: Gustav Potter views the piano as a meditative device. The piano is a balancing mechanism, here to spiritually re-adjust your soul as a chiropractor might. Lean back, take a deep breath, and soak in the peaceful notes.

name: Mindy Thurma
bio: Welcome to my universe of piano compositions. Since my earliest years, the keys have served as a conduit for those visceral emotions that transcend language—the overwhelming, the melancholic, the peaks, and the valleys. Here, music is a space where one can exist in their entirety, embracing both the shadow and the light. My hope is that you find solace and a sense of sanctuary within these notes, just as I have.

name: Chris Rusak
